m200570.――物質界の海水すべてがスライムになるでしょうね。: ――and all the seawater in the material world will turn into slime.
m200570.――王子には一応、あの後のことを報告しておこうかな。: ――I suppose I should give the Prince a brief report on what happened afterward.
m200570.――真夏のぷるぷるビーチ、爆破と共に終幕です！！: ――The Midsummer Jiggly Beach, concluding in a blast!!
m200570.……いいえ、そういうわけにはいかないみたいよ？: ……No, I'm afraid it's not that simple.
m200570.……おそらくは先程の戦闘の衝撃で、\n装置内部に異常が発生してしまったのでしょう:
……It is likely that the impact from the recent battle
caused an internal malfunction in the device.
As a result, it has become uncontrollable.
m200570.……このローパー、\n生かしておくには危険すぎるんじゃないか？:
……This Rooper is
too dangerous to keep alive, don't you think?
m200570.……せっかく海に来たのです。\n難しい話はやめて、みんなたくさん遊びましょうか♪:
……Since we've come all this way to the beach,
let's leave the difficult talk behind and have lots of fun, everyone♪
m200570.……そうですね！\n死傷者も出ませんでしたからね！:
……Yes!
After all, no one was killed or injured!
m200570.……それで、ローパー博士から装置を盗んだわけか。: ……So that's why you stole the device from Professor Loper.
m200570.……とのことですので、一丁参加してみましょうか。: ……Well, if that's the case, I suppose I'll join in for a bit.
m200570.……どうにもやり辛いな。\n私たちのことはいいから、\nさっさと水着スライムを追:
……This is getting awkward.
Forget about us.
Let's hurry up and catch up to the Swimsuit Slime.
m200570.……なぜか海がピンク色になっていますが。: ……Though for some reason, the sea has turned pink.
m200570.……なんかこの海、ねちゃねちゃしてるけど！: ……But why does this sea feel so slimy!
m200570.……まぁ、一度砦に戻ろうか。\nちょっと身体を洗いたいし。:
……Though, let's head back to the fortress for now.

I really need to wash up.
m200570.……ローパー博士と助手スライムだ。: ……It's Dr. Looper and his assistant slime.
m200570.……夏だからね。\nちょっとくらい、はめを外したくなるものだよ。:
……It is summer, after all.
Anyone would want to let their hair down a little.
m200570.……思ったよりも被害は大きいようですね。: ……It seems the damage is more extensive than I thought.
m200570.……本当にごめんなさい。\n償いになるかは分からないけど……装置はもう、止めるね:
……I'm truly sorry.
I don't know if this will make up for it, but…… I'll shut the device down.
m200570.……海で泳ぎたかったから。: ……Because I wanted to swim in the sea.
m200570.……責任を感じたのでついてきてみたのですが、\nいざ被害者の声を聞くと反省の気持: Dr. Rooper: I came along because I felt responsible, but… hearing the victims' stories firsthand really makes me feel the weight of my actions.
m200570.……貴様ら人間に分かるか？\nある日突然、海中全体が、\n半固体のねばついた物体: ……Can you humans even understand? The terror of the entire ocean suddenly turning into a semi-solid, sticky mass.
m200570.……逃げるぞ！\nここまできて爆発に巻き込まれたくはない！:
……Run!
I have no desire to be caught in an explosion after coming this far!
m200570.あ、あんまり無茶はしないでねー！\nうっかり大怪我したら大変だからー！: Ah, please don't do anything reckless! If you accidentally get badly hurt, it'll be a disaster!
m200570.あぁ……創作意欲が湧いてくる……。\n早くこの出来事を歌いたい……。: Ah…… my creative inspiration is surging…… I can't wait to sing of this event……
m200570.ああ、待ってください。武器を構えないで。\n私が装置を暴走させたとかではありませ:
Oh, wait. Please lower your weapons.
I didn't cause the device to malfunction or anything.
m200570.ああ！ やるぜ博士！\n予定調和みたいにぶっ倒される未来しか見えねぇが、\n諦め:
Yessir! Let's do this, Doc!
I can only see a future where we get flattened like it was all part of the plan,
but if I give up, that's where it ends for us!!
m200570.あっちでは初代陛下と初代騎士団長と、\n王国軍初代副司令官が斬り合ってるぞーッ！: Over there, the First Emperor, the First Knight Commander, and the Kingdom's First Vice-Commander are dueling!
m200570.あの……止めなくていいんですか？\n演習の規模ではないと思うんですが……。: Um…… aren't we supposed to stop them? This seems to have gone beyond the scope of an exercise……
m200570.あの後、海水に浸かっても大丈夫になる発明品を\nローパー博士からもらっていたから:
After that, she received an invention from Dr. Looper
that allows her to withstand seawater,
so I doubt she'll go out of control again.
m200570.あー、いいわね、最高だと思うわ。（無感情）: Ah, that sounds good. I think it's the best. (flatly)
m200570.い、いいの……？\n私は悪いことをしたのに、こんなによくしてもらって……。:
R-really……?
I did something wrong, yet you're being so kind to me…….
m200570.いいですね、変化……。\nこの調子で白の帝国が、\n超火力主義国家になったりしな:
How wonderful, change…….
At this rate, won't the White Empire
turn into a nation that worships overwhelming firepower?
m200570.いいね、食べ終わる頃には、\nダグマールたちもこっちに来てるだろうし。:
Sounds good. By the time we're done eating,
Dagmar and the others will probably have made their way over here.
m200570.いえ、おそらくこれは違います。\n実際に泳いでみたから分かるのですが――:
No, I don't think so.
I actually went for a swim, and I can tell that——
m200570.いきますよ助手スライムくん！\n正直、王国軍と帝国軍を同時に相手取るのは、\n絶:
Let's go, Assistant Slime!

Honestly, facing the Kingdom and Empire armies at once

is more than just despairing!!
m200570.いっぱいはしゃいで、ひと夏の思い出を作ろうね♪:
Let's have a blast and make some summer memories♪
--- scene: The Sea Turns to Slime ---
m200570.いつの間にかついてきていた博士は黙っててください。: Doctor, who showed up out of nowhere, please keep quiet.
m200570.いつの間にか帝国の兵士たちも、\n王国の文化に染まってしまったわね。:
It seems the Empire's soldiers have
been thoroughly influenced by Kingdom culture without anyone noticing.
m200570.いよいよもって、放っておけなくなりました。\n一刻も早く海底に向かい、この事態を: I can no longer just stand by. We must head to the sea floor immediately and bring this situation under control.
m200570.う、うわぁああああっ！？\n雷と風が襲いかかって来るぞーッ！？: Ugh, what the hell?! Lightning and wind are coming at us!
m200570.うぅ……どこにも逃げ場がない……！\nもう駄目だぁ……死ぬしかないんだぁ……！:
Ugh…… There's nowhere left to run……!
It's over…… I have no choice but to die……!
m200570.うぅ、迷惑をかけて、ごめんなさい……。: Ugh, I'm so sorry for causing all this trouble……
m200570.うおぉぉおおおおっ！\n次は海で模擬戦だァー！！:
Woohoooooo!
Next up is a sparring match in the sea!!
m200570.うん……私、色んな人に迷惑をかけちゃった。: Yeah…… I've caused so much trouble for everyone.
m200570.ええ、その認識で問題ありませんよ。\n内部の機関……リミッターが壊れたようですね:
Yes, your understanding is correct.
It appears the internal mechanism…… the limiter, has broken.
m200570.えーと、いきなり倒したりするつもりはありませんから、\nまずは色々と話しを聞かせ:
Um, we have no intention of attacking you out of the blue.
Please, tell us what's going on——
m200570.えーと、初代騎士団長は照れ隠しするように、\n一行に声をかけて……。（メモメモ）: Um, the First Knight Commander seemed to be hiding his embarrassment as he called out to the group…… (scribbling notes)
m200570.おっと、なんだか雲行きが怪しくなってきたね？: Oh my, the atmosphere is getting a bit ominous, isn't it?
m200570.おーい！ そこの人たちー！\nそんなところでお喋りしてる場合じゃないわよー！: Hey! You guys over there! Now's not the time to be chatting!
m200570.おーい！ スイカ割ったからみんなで食べましょー！！: Hey, everyone! I cut the watermelon, so let's all eat!!
m200570.きゃああ！？ か、身体が勝手に動いて……！？: Kyaa!? M-my body is moving on its own……!?
m200570.ぎゃぁぁああああっ！？\n泳ぎに来ていたら突然現れた海の魔物に襲われたぜ！\nも:
Gyaahhhh!?
I was just swimming and suddenly got attacked by sea monsters!
I'm too scared to do anything but run!
m200570.ぎゃあぁあああああっ！？\nわけわかんない高火力のビームが飛び交ってるーッ！？: Yikes! I can't make sense of this! High-output beams are flying all over the place!
m200570.くだらないことを書かなくていいから！: Please stop writing down such nonsense!
m200570.くだらないって思ったでしょ？\nでもね、私たちは海で泳げないのよ。:
You probably think it's ridiculous, don't you?
But, you see, we can't swim in the sea.
m200570.くっ、身から出た錆というやつですかね！\n全面的に悪いのは私たちですが、\nそれ:
Tsk, it's our own fault, isn't it?

We bear full responsibility,

but I still don't want to die!!
m200570.ぐっ……まったくもって、運がないな……！\n棲家を失った上に、人間共にも負けるの:
Ghh…… what bad luck……!
Not only have we lost our home,
but we've also lost to humans……!
m200570.こうして得難い体験ができるのはいいですね。\n今日の事件を詩に書く際に、\nより: It's nice that we can gain such a rare experience. It will allow for more realistic expressions when I write a poem about today's incident.
m200570.こうなったら仕方がない。\nとりあえずしばき倒して、\nなにをやらかしたのかを問:
Well, there's no help for it now.
Let's beat them down first,
then we can demand an explanation for what they've done.
m200570.ここで戦わなければ損ということだな。\nせっかくの機会だから、飛び込んでみてはど: Not joining in would be a waste. Since we have the chance, why don't you dive right in?
m200570.ここで黄昏ててもしょうがねぇけど、\n全然ナイスなアイデアとか思い浮かばねぇしな:
Lying around here won't help,

but I can't think of a single good idea.
m200570.ここのふたりって仲良いのね。: Those two get along well, don't they?
m200570.このような事故が起きないように、\n次からは説明書を付けておきますね。:
To prevent accidents like this from happening again,
I'll make sure to include a manual next time.
m200570.この子は良心の呵責に耐えられなかったんだろうね。\nそのせいで、やけくそになって:
It seems she couldn't bear the guilt.
That's why she's lashing out in a fit of despair.
m200570.この近辺で、元凶と思しき不審人物が\nうろうろしているところを見つけたらしい。:
However, they spotted a suspicious figure
wandering around the area who is likely the culprit.
m200570.これだけド派手だと、なんてことない合同演習も、\nとても華やかなものに感じられま: With all this spectacle, even an ordinary joint exercise feels truly magnificent.
m200570.こんなに砕けた態度で接することができるんだから、\nそれだけ気心知れた関係なのね: The fact that you can be so casual with each other shows just how close you two are♪
m200570.さすがは元ディアス配下の人。\nなかなかにキマっていますね。: Typical of someone who was under Dias's command. You're really in the zone.
m200570.さて、話はそれくらいでいいですよね。: Well, that should be enough about that.
m200570.しかし、その分いい模擬戦になった。\n結果的に今回の合同演習は大成功だったと言え:
Still, it made for a rather enjoyable sparring match.
In the end, I suppose we can call this joint exercise a great success.
m200570.しかもどろどろの海の中からは、\n狂暴なスライムが絶え間なく湧き出てくるのだ。\: And on top of that, frenzied slimes keep welling up endlessly from that sludgy sea. There's no way anyone could live in a place like that.
m200570.じゃあなんだ、ピンク色の染まったこの海一帯が、\n全部スライムになっているという:
So you're saying that this entire area of pink-tinged sea
is all slime……?
m200570.じゃあなんで海がスライムになってるのよ。: Then why is the sea turned into slime?
m200570.すげぇ！ 多少怪我しても癒し手が治してくれるぜ！\nこれならいくらでも模擬戦でき: Whoa! Even if we get hurt, the healers will fix us right up! We can keep fighting as long as we want!
m200570.ずっとずっとスライムの海の中で、\n海水浴をしちゃうんだからー！！:
I'm going to stay in this slime sea forever
and enjoy my swim!!
m200570.せっかく海に来たんだから、\nめいっぱい楽しみたかったのになぁ……。:
I really wanted to have as much fun as possible
since we finally made it to the beach……
m200570.せっかく海に来ているのです。\nここからは、共にバカンスを楽しみましょう♪:
We've come all this way to the beach.
From here on, let's all enjoy our vacation together♪
m200570.そういう君も、\nジュース片手に浮かれているように見えるけど。:
And yet, you seem to be in quite a festive mood yourself,
sipping on a juice.
m200570.そういえば貴方って技師だったわね。\n火力の話しかしないから忘れていたわ。:
Oh right, you were an engineer, weren't you?
You only ever talk about firepower, so I had forgotten.
m200570.そうか、お前が元凶か。\n千発くらい殴らせてもらうぞ。: So you're the one responsible. I'm going to beat you about a thousand times.
m200570.そうしたらきっと、海は元に戻るはずだから。: Once I do, the sea should return to normal.
m200570.そうそう、ローパー博士と助手スライムだけど、\n連中は後片付けをさっさと終えて、:
Oh, and Dr. Looper and his assistant slime
finished the cleanup quickly and then vanished.
m200570.そうだね、被害が出る前に、\n魔物たちの対処をしよう。\nスライムのことはその後:
That's right. Let's deal with the monsters
before any damage is done.
We can worry about the slime afterwards.
m200570.そうでしたか……。\nやはり火力が足りなかったのですね……。:
I see……
So my firepower really wasn't enough after all……
m200570.そうなんじゃないかしら？\nその証拠にほら、海からスライムが大量に湧きだしてるわ:
I suspect so.
As proof, look, slimes are pouring out of the sea in droves.
m200570.そうね……楽しい模擬戦で誰かが命を落したりしたら、\n優しい王子が心を痛めてしま: That's true…… if someone died in a fun sparring match, the gentle Prince would be heartbroken.
m200570.そうね！ みんなで泳いだり、\n水をかけ合って遊ぶのは楽しいわ！: Yeah! It's so much fun swimming and splashing around with everyone!
m200570.そこまで殺気立ってるわけではないだろうけど、\n君たちは帝国で好き放題してくれた:
I'm not quite that murderous, but

you did run wild in the Empire, didn't you?
m200570.そちらの管理ミスについて言いたいことは山ほどあるが、\nスライムのお嬢さんという:
I have a mountain of complaints about your lack of security,
but who is this “young lady made of slime”?
m200570.そのためには水着スライムと、\nスライム増産装置を見つけないといけないわけだけど: To do that, we need to find the Swimsuit Slime and the slime mass-production device, but……
m200570.そのスライム増産装置が先日、\nスライムのお嬢さんに盗まれましてね。\nそれで気:
A few days ago, that Slime Mass Production Device
was stolen by a young lady made of slime.
Before I knew it, the sea had become this.
m200570.そのリミッターとやらが壊れたらどうなるんだい？: What happens when that limiter breaks?
m200570.そもそもだけど、あなたはどうしてこんなことをしたの？: But first, why did you do this?
m200570.そもそもだけど、あなたはなにを作ったの？: But first, what exactly did you build?
m200570.そもそも入らない方が良かったんじゃないかな……。: Honestly, it would have been better if we hadn't gone in at all…
m200570.それが壊れてしまった以上、\nスライム化は際限なく進行し――:
Now that it is broken,
the slime-ification will progress without limit――
m200570.それで、この事態をどう解決するかなのですが……。: So, how do we go about resolving this situation…….
m200570.それで海の魔物たちも拳を収めたみたいでね。\nまぁ、その辺りのことは円満解決した:
As a result, the sea monsters have put away their fists.
I suppose you can say that matter was resolved amicably.
m200570.それに、せっかくの夏休みなのです。: Besides, it's a precious summer vacation.
m200570.それにしても、海がスライムになっているなんて驚きね。: Still, I'm amazed that the sea itself has turned into slime.
m200570.それはそうでしょう。\nスライムを消し飛ばしたところで、\n根本的な解決になると:
That's only natural.
Even if we blew the slimes away,
I don't think it would solve the root of the problem.
m200570.そんな状態でよく生きていられるね……。: I can't believe you're still alive in that state…
m200570.た、助かったぁ……。\nありがとうね、人間さんたち……。:
I…… I'm saved…….
Thank you, humans…….
m200570.た、大変……！\nぼろぼろスライムになっちゃう……！:
Oh no……!
I'm falling apart into slime……!
m200570.だけど……まさか、こんなことになるなんて……。: But…… I never imagined things would end up like this……
m200570.だけど私は、人間みたいに普通に海水浴を楽しみたかった。\nそのためには海水そのも:
But I wanted to enjoy a normal day at the beach, just like humans do.
To do that, I needed to change the seawater itself……
m200570.でも、だからこそ……もう、ね？\n行くところまで行っちゃうしかないのかなって。:
But, because of that…… I guess, right?
I might as well go all the way.
m200570.というか解決をお願いします……！\n本来ならこちらでしなければならないことですが:
Dr. Rooper: Or rather, I am *begging* you to resolve it……!
This is something we should be handling,
but we are completely out of our depth……!
m200570.というわけで王子くん。\nこの夏は私たちにたくさん付き合ってね♪:
So, Prince.
Please keep us company a lot this summer♪
m200570.というわけで王子殿、この辺りの海は、\nスライムになってしまっているようだ。:
So, Your Highness, it appears that the sea
in this area has turned into slime.
m200570.ともかく、海を元に戻すには、\nスライムのお嬢さん……水着スライムと呼びましょう:
In any case, to restore the sea,
we need to find the young lady made of slime… let's call her the Swimsuit Slime.
m200570.とりあえず、皆さん陸に上がってきてください。\n無理やり海水浴をするのは中止にし:
For now, everyone please come up onto the shore.
Let's call off the forced beach trip.
m200570.とりあえずなんで海がスライム化しているのかとか、\nここでなにが起きているのかは:
Anyway, we need to investigate why the sea turned into slime

and what's actually going on here…
m200570.とりあえず倒せはしたけど……。: We managed to take them down, but……
m200570.とんだ邪魔が入ったものだ。\nしかし、こちらも死活問題だからな。:
What an unwelcome interruption.
However, this is a matter of life and death for us.
m200570.どういたしまして。\nそれじゃあ、みんなで地上に帰ろっか。:
You're welcome.
Well then, let's all head back to the surface.
m200570.どうしたの、レミィ？ 変な声出しちゃって。: What's wrong, Remii? You made a strange noise.
m200570.どうしましょうね、助手スライムくん。\nもはや私たちだけで解決することは不可能で:
What can we do, Assistant Slime?

It's impossible for us to resolve this on our own.
m200570.どうせ私は悪いスライムなんだから！\nじゃあとことん悪くなっちゃうよ！:
I'm a bad slime anyway!
So I might as well be completely rotten to the core!
m200570.どうでしょう、王子殿下。: What do you say, Your Highness?
m200570.どうやらおかしな壊れ方をしたようですね。\n回路がショートしてエネルギーが暴発寸:
It appears to have malfunctioned in a rather peculiar way.
The circuit has shorted out, and the energy is on the verge of a violent discharge.
m200570.どうやらこの規模の被害が出るとは\n想像できなかったみたいだね。: It seems she didn't imagine the damage would be on this scale.
m200570.どうやらアブグルントたちも参戦するようですね。: It seems Abgrund and the others are joining the fray as well.
m200570.どうやら悪いことをしたという自覚はあるみたいね。: It seems to realize it did something wrong.
m200570.どのみち装置は壊さないといけないんだ。\nついでに操られているスライムたちも解放:
We have to destroy the device anyway.
Let's free the slimes being controlled while we're at it.
m200570.なにが峰打ちだよ！？\n俺の身体、真っ二つになってんだけど！？:
What do you mean “back of the head”!?
My body is split in two!
m200570.なにが目的かは知らないが、\n人々に仇なすつもりなら容赦はしないぞ。:
I don't know what your goal is,
but if you intend to harm the people, we will show no mercy.
m200570.なので一日お待ちを。\nすぐに作って、スライムのお嬢さんが\n海を楽しめるように:
So please wait one day.
I'll make one right away so the slime girl can
enjoy the sea.
m200570.ならば、私たちで止めてあげましょう。\nこのままでは、誰も幸せにはなりませんから:
Then let us stop her ourselves.
As it stands, no one will be happy.
m200570.なんか、装置の様子がおかしくない……？\nバチバチって帯電してるように見えるんだ:
Doesn't the device look a little off?
It's sparking and crackling like it's charged up……!
m200570.なんか今回はみんな無茶しちゃいそうだから、\n早く海に行きたいなぁ……。:
It feels like everyone's about to get a little too carried away this time, so
I can't wait to get to the beach…….
m200570.なんだか変な覚悟を決めちゃったようですね。\nあちらは完全にやる気みたいですよ。:
They seem to have made up their minds in a rather peculiar way.
The other side looks fully prepared to fight.
m200570.なんだこの妙に説明口調な人間は……！: What is with this human's overly explanatory tone……!
m200570.なんで海底に……まさか、私を討伐しに来たの！？\nその、海をスライムにしちゃった: Why are you all in the ocean…… No way, are you here to defeat me!?
m200570.なんとか落ち着かせることができたみたいね。: It looks like we managed to calm her down.
m200570.なんやかんやで普通の海が一番ってことね！: So, in the end, a normal sea is the best!
m200570.にわかには信じられないけど、\n感触は完全にスライムだったわ。:
It's hard to believe, but
the texture was definitely that of slime.
m200570.はぁ……責めるようなことを言って悪かったよ。\nだから機嫌を直してくれないかな？: Sigh…… I'm sorry for saying something hurtful.
m200570.ははは、いくら私が天才博士だとしても、\nそんな都合よく発明品を持ってたりはしま:
Hahaha, no matter how much of a genius I am,
I don't happen to have such a convenient invention on hand.
m200570.ひんやりしてて、ぷるぷるで……。\n不謹慎かもだけど、ちょっと面白いわ。: It's cool and wobbly…… It might be a bit tasteless, but it's kind of fun.
m200570.ふふっ、どうやらひと夏の冒険は、\n熱い爆破オチで終わるようですね。:
Heh, it seems our summer adventure is going to end
with a fiery bang.
m200570.ふふっ、久しぶりの海遊びは楽しいですね♪: Hehe, it's so nice to be playing in the sea again after so long♪
m200570.ふふっ、夏休みはまだまだはじまったばかり。\nだからどうか、覚悟してくださいね。:
Heh, summer break has only just begun.
So please, brace yourselves.
m200570.ふむ……ローパー博士に質問なのですが……。: Hmm…… I have a question for Dr. Rooper.
m200570.ふむ……今更言い訳をしても意味がありませんね。\n観念して、すべてを話すとしまし:
Hmm… making excuses now would be pointless.
I suppose I should just accept it and tell you everything.
m200570.ふむ……海がスライムになった原因を突き止めることは、\nどうやらできなかったみた:
Hmm…… apparently they couldn't determine
what caused the sea to turn into slime……
m200570.まぁ、いなくなる分には問題ない。\nこの調子で海辺を制圧するとしよう。:
Well, it's no problem if they leave.
Let's continue securing the coastline.
m200570.まぁ、そう遠くには行っていないはずだ。\n探せばまた見つかると思うよ。: Well, it probably hasn't gone far.
m200570.まぁまぁ、そんな縮こまらないでくれ。\n今回の件は事故みたいなものだったのだろう:
Come now, don't be so down.
This whole affair was essentially an accident, wasn't it?
m200570.まず、今回の騒動を引き起こした水着スライムだけど、\n彼女はとても反省しているみ:
First, regarding the Swimsuit Slime who caused this commotion,
she seems to be very remorseful,
and she's actively helping with the cleanup.
m200570.また胡乱な存在が増えましたね……。\nというかスライムって水着とか着るのですか？:
Another dubious entity appears…
Wait, do slimes wear swimsuits?
m200570.まったく……夏休みだからって浮かれすぎだよ。: Honestly…… you're getting way too carried away just because it's summer break.
m200570.まったく、仕方がありませんね。\n別に全然拗ねたりなんてしていませんでしたが、\: Honestly, I suppose I have no choice.
m200570.みんながとぼとぼと上がってきたところで。\nなにが起きているのか真面目に考えると:
Now that everyone is trudging back up the shore,
let's seriously consider what is actually happening.
m200570.みんな遊ぶ準備はばっちりみたいね！\nそれじゃあ早速、泳ぎにいきましょ！:
Everyone seems to be fully prepared for some fun!
Then let's not waste any time and go for a swim!
m200570.む……貴様らは、王国軍と帝国軍か。\n人間共の悲鳴を聞いて駆けつけてきたようだな:
Hmph…… so you are the Kingdom and Empire armies.
You must have rushed over at the sound of the humans' screams.
m200570.もしかして……大事件が起きてる……？: Could it be that…… a major incident is happening……?
m200570.もしかしなくても大事件だ……！\nとにかく、湧いてきたスライムを倒すぞ！:
It's a major incident whether we like it or not……!
Anyway, let's defeat the slimes that are emerging!
m200570.や、やめてください！\n本当に……本当にそういうのはやめてくださいね！？: P-Please don't! Seriously…… please stop with that kind of thing!
m200570.やばいぜ博士！ あの初代皇帝、\n完全に俺たちを殺る気だぜ！？:
This is bad, Doctor! That First Emperor

is absolutely going to kill us!
m200570.やることは決まったかしら。: Well, it seems we know what we need to do.
m200570.スイカを食べたら、次はみんなで泳ぎましょうか。: Once we've finished the watermelon, how about we all go for a swim?
m200570.スライムでも海を泳げるようになる発明品などは、\n作っていたりしないのですか？:
Have you perhaps invented anything
that would allow slimes to swim in the sea?
m200570.スライムの海なら、私たちの身体も溶けたりしないから。: If the sea were made of slime, our bodies wouldn't dissolve.
m200570.スライムまみれの夏休み。\nこの出来事に題名をつけるならば、そう――:
A summer vacation drenched in slime.
If I were to give this event a title, it would be this――
m200570.スライム化やらで被害にあった海の魔物たちに、\nしっかり補填をしてから行方をくら:
It appears they made proper compensation to the sea monsters
who were affected by the sliming before disappearing.
m200570.スライム増産装置によるスライム化は、\n今までリミッターによる制限のおかげで、\:
The slime-ification caused by the Slime Mass Production Device
has been confined to the seas near the Empire
thanks to the restrictions imposed by the limiter.
m200570.ド派手っていうより阿鼻叫喚じゃないかな？: “Spectacle”? I'd call it a total bloodbath.
m200570.ローパー博士のことは王子殿と相談するとして、\nそれより今はスライム増産装置だ。:
Let's discuss Dr. Rooper with the Prince later.
Right now, we need to focus on the Slime Mass Production Device.
m200570.ローパー博士の発明品は、\n思っていたよりも高性能だったってことなのかな。: I suppose Professor Loper's invention was more powerful than we expected.
m200570.ローパー博士はボコボコになってもらうとして。\n海の魔物たちのためにも、\n早く: Assuming Dr. Rooper gets a thorough beating, we should try to resolve this as soon as possible for the sake of the sea monsters.
m200570.ローパー博士を野放しにすると、\n絶対ろくなことにならないと思うけど……。\n彼:
If we leave Dr. Looper to his own devices,
it absolutely won't end well……
I'll leave the decision on them to the Prince.
m200570.久しぶりの海でテンションが上がってるね。\nまぁ、それは私たちも同じだけど。:
You're quite excited about the beach after being away from it for so long.
Well, we're feeling the same way, though.
m200570.今の帝国は変革期だ。\n良くも悪くも変わっていくということかもしれないね。:
The Empire is in a period of transformation.
For better or worse, things are changing, it seems.
m200570.今回はこういう人たちばっかりだから、\n早く海での遊びに切り替えたいなぁ……！:
With this bunch here,
I really want to switch over to some beach fun already……!
m200570.他にやることがあるんだし、\nこいつらはさっさと倒すわよ！:
We have other things to do, so
let's take these guys down quickly!
m200570.元々はスライム化した水を制御するための機能でしたが、\n暴走により外敵排除に使わ:
It was originally a function for controlling the slime-ified water,
but it appears to be repurposed for eliminating external threats due to the malfunction.
m200570.元凶ですか……。\nそれで、その不審人物とやらは何者なんです？:
The culprit……
And who is this suspicious figure, exactly?
m200570.先に解決しなければならない問題が発生したようですね。: It appears we have a more pressing issue to deal with first.
m200570.分かりきっていたことだけれど、\n大人しく始末されるつもりはないみたいね。:
I knew it, but it seems
they have no intention of going down quietly.
m200570.分けるには少し大きいから、\nお姉ちゃんが食べやすいように切っておくね♪:
It's a bit too big to share out as is,
so I'll cut it into slices so it's easy for everyone to eat♪
m200570.勢いで攻撃しちゃったけど、\nこの魔物たちってもしかして、\nスライム化の被害者:
I attacked on a whim, but
could these monsters actually be
victims of the slime transformation……?
m200570.合同演習にはそこまでそそられませんが……。\n水着姿の美女がこうも揃うと、さすが: I'm not particularly drawn to joint exercises, but…… seeing so many beautiful women in swimsuits is quite the sight.
m200570.名立たる強者が集まっていたからね。\nつい熱くなってしまったよ。: With so many renowned strong fighters gathered, it's easy to get carried away.
m200570.君に手荒な真似をするつもりはない。\n事が事だから、罰として後始末に協力してもら:
I have no intention of harming you.
Given the circumstances, I will ask for your help in cleaning up the mess as a form of punishment, but
I am not thinking of taking your life.
m200570.君はいつまで拗ねてるんだい。: How long are you going to keep sulking?
m200570.吟遊詩人としてこのような終わり方はどうかと思いますが、\nしかして私は真実の歴史:
As a bard, I find such an ending rather unsatisfying,
but I am one who tells the true history.
I shall make sure to immortalize this explosion in verse.
m200570.問題はどうやって水着スライムとやらを\n捜索するかですが――:
The problem is how we go about searching
for this so-called Swimsuit Slime――
m200570.夏休み、帝国近辺の海辺にて――: (narration): Summer break, on a beach near the Empire――
m200570.夏季休暇を利用した、\n王国と帝国による合同演習ですか。: A joint exercise between the Kingdom and the Empire, held during the summer vacation, is it?
m200570.多少の制裁は覚悟してもらおうかな。: You should be prepared for a bit of a punishment.
m200570.大丈夫だよ、すぐに助けるから。: It's okay, I'll help you right away.
m200570.大袈裟ですね。\n峰打ちで済ませてあげたので、\n命に別状はないはずですよ。:
You're being dramatic.
I only struck you on the back of the head,
so you should be perfectly fine.
m200570.実験でたくさん失敗してきた私ですが、\nこの規模のミスははじめてなので、\n途方:
I've failed plenty of experiments in my time,

but a mistake on this scale is a first.

I'm completely at a loss.
m200570.少し前まで海が桃色になっていたり、\nどろどろになっていたりしたからかな。\nた:
After the sea turned pink and then turned to sludge not long ago,
it's a bit bittersweet to just be able to enjoy the ocean like this.
m200570.帝国がこの先どのように変わっていくのか。\nとても興味深くはあるけれど……。:
How the Empire will change going forward.
It is certainly very interesting, but…….
m200570.帝国の海事情には詳しくないのだが、\n普通に赤潮とかではないのか？:
I'm not well-versed in the Empire's maritime affairs,
but isn't this just a regular red tide?
m200570.帝国軍もいますよ。\nさて、色々と話を聞かせてもらいましょうか。:
The Empire's forces are here too.

Now then, let's hear everything you have to say.
m200570.常識人たちの心からの叫びが聞こえるね。: I can hear the heartfelt cries of the sensible people.
m200570.彼らの生態に多少興味が湧いてきたけど、\nそれより今はスライム化した海についてだ:
I'm becoming a bit interested in their biology,
but right now, the slime-ified sea is the priority.
m200570.復活してからはじめての海だったのですがね……。: It was supposed to be my first time at the sea since my revival……
m200570.心当たりがあるようだな。: It seems you have an idea where they are.
m200570.恐縮です。それでローパー博士。\n制作者であるあなたに聞きますが、\n私の見立て:
My apologies. And so, Dr. Rooper.
As the creator, I ask you:
is my assessment correct?
m200570.我々は彼女を探すことができませんでしたが、\n王国軍と帝国軍の力があれば、きっと:
Dr. Rooper: We were unable to locate her ourselves,
but with the combined strength of the Kingdom and Empire armies,
we should be able to resolve this.
m200570.我らはあの魔物を排除することができなかったが……。\nあれをどうにかできれば、海: We were unable to eliminate that monster, but…… if we can deal with it, will the sea return to normal?
m200570.探し人ならぬ探しスライムは見つかったようだね。\nとりあえず話しかけてみようか。:
So we've found the slime we were looking for.
Let's try talking to it.
m200570.文字通りスライムのお嬢さんですよ。\n水着を着た、可愛らしいスライムです。:
She is, quite literally, a young lady made of slime.
A cute slime wearing a swimsuit.
m200570.本当にね！ すっごくひやひやしたよぉ！:
Really!
I was so nervous for a while there!
m200570.模擬戦は今だけで、これが終わったら、\nあとは全日程バカンスだものね♪: The sparring is just for now. Once this is over, the rest of the schedule is all vacation♪
m200570.機械のこの反応……！ い、いけません！\n装置が爆発しそうになっています！:
This reaction from the machinery……! N-no, this is bad!
The device is about to explode!
m200570.止める必要はないでしょう？\nだってみんな楽しそうだもの。（無関心）: No need to stop them. Everyone looks like they're having fun. (Indifferent)
m200570.残念ながら適当に返事をしたアブグルントさん以外の\n賛同を得られることはできなか:
Unfortunately, I failed to gain the support of anyone
other than Ms. Abgrund, who gave a rather casual reply…….
m200570.水着を着たスライムだね……。: It's a slime in a swimsuit……
m200570.水着スライムと、スライム増産装置……。: The Swimsuit Slime and the slime mass-production device……
m200570.水着スライムを見つけ出し、\n彼女が持っているであろう装置を停止、\nもしくは破:
Dr. Rooper: We need to find the Swimsuit Slime and stop,
or destroy, the device she must be carrying.
m200570.水着姿なのが仇になりましたね。\n素肌にスライムがまとわりついて、\nべとべとに:
Wearing a swimsuit really backfired.

The slime stuck to my bare skin,

and now I'm all sticky…
m200570.水着姿のスライムさん。\nあなたはここでなにをしているんですか？:
Excuse me, swimsuit slime.
What are you doing out here?
m200570.泳いでる時になんか痛い気がすると思ったら、\nそういうことだったのね！:
I thought it felt weirdly painful while I was swimming,

turns out that's why!
m200570.海から増援がくる様子もない。\n一旦は落ち着いたと見ていいか。:
There's no sign of reinforcements coming from the sea.

We can consider the situation stable for now.
m200570.海がこんなになるなんて、\nいったいなにをやっちゃったの？:
For the sea to end up like this…
what on earth did you do?
m200570.海がスライムから海水に戻りはじめている。\n私たちはともかく、スライムの君は危な:
The sea is starting to turn back from slime to seawater.
Regardless of us, aren't you in danger, slime girl?
m200570.海で暮らす魔物にとって、\n海水がスライムに変わるというのは、\n致命的な問題だ: So for the monsters who live in the sea, the seawater turning into slime was a fatal problem, I see.
m200570.海の中からスライムが湧きだしてきたね。: Slimes are emerging from the sea.
m200570.海底に水着を着たおかしなスライムが居座っている。\nこれまたおかしな機械を脇に抱: A strange slime wearing a swimsuit has set up camp on the seabed. It's clutching another strange machine.
m200570.海水が丸ごと全部スライムに置き換わっている感じかな。\nいやはや、いったいなにが:
It's as if the seawater has been entirely replaced by slime.
Goodness, what on earth could have happened?
m200570.火力はともかく、\nスライム化した海についての調査報告が届いたようだぞ。:
Setting firepower aside,
it seems a report on the slime-ified sea has just arrived.
m200570.無言で私を睨まないでよ。: Stop glaring at me in silence.
m200570.熱心な吟遊詩人もいいけど、\n今はもっと相手にすべき存在がいるよ。: A passionate bard is all well and good, but there's something more we should be dealing with right now.
m200570.王子くんみたいに喋らなくなっちゃったわね。: You've stopped talking like the Prince.
m200570.異常を感じた時点で上がってきてくださいよ……。: You should have gotten out the moment you felt something was off…
m200570.発明者のローパー博士曰く、元通りになるそうです。: According to the inventor, Dr. Rooper, it should return to normal.
m200570.破壊してしまえばすべての問題は解決するはずです。\nただ、一筋縄ではいかないよう:
If we destroy it, all our problems will be solved.
But it doesn't look like it'll be that easy……!
m200570.私たちの身体はスライムだから、\n海水に触れると水分が抜けてしなしなになったり、:
Since our bodies are made of slime,
when we touch seawater, we either lose our moisture and turn into a puddle, or
we dissolve in strange ways and turn into a mess.
m200570.私たちは、貴方を逃がしたりしませんから♪: We're not going to let you escape us♪
m200570.私は圧倒的な火力で、\n海のスライムをまとめて蒸発させることを、\n先ほど皆さん:
I just proposed to everyone that we use
overwhelming firepower to evaporate
the sea slime all at once.
m200570.私も胴体が分離してしまったのですが……。: My torso has separated as well, but…
m200570.結論から話しますと、\n海がこうなってしまったのは、私の発明品が原因です。:
To get straight to the point,
the reason the sea is like this is due to one of my inventions.
m200570.絶対海で遊んでる場合じゃないよ。\n見るからにおかしなことになってるし。:
There's absolutely no way we should be playing in the sea right now.
It clearly looks like something is wrong.
m200570.肝心の水着スライムは逃がしてしまいましたが……。: We did let the swimsuit slime get away, though……
m200570.装置から異常な電磁波が放出されています！\nどうやらそれが周囲のスライムを操って:
The device is emitting abnormal electromagnetic waves!
It seems to be controlling the slimes in the area!
m200570.装置が完全に停止したようです。\nこれでもう、彼女たちが操られることはありません:
The device seems to have shut down completely.
This means they won't be controlled anymore.
m200570.装置一つで海一帯がスライムになるなんて、\n分かるはずがないのだから。:
There was no way she could have known that a single device
would turn the entire sea into slime.
m200570.襲いかかってきたスライムたちはすべて倒せましたね。: We've taken down all the slimes that came at us.
m200570.詩に書くことが増えるので、\n私もこのままで大丈夫だと思います。: It gives me plenty of material for my poetry, so I think I'll just let it play out.
m200570.誠に申し訳ありませんが、何卒……！！: Dr. Rooper: I am truly sorry, but please……!!
m200570.説得できればよかったのですが、\nどうやら武力を行使するしかないようですね。: I had hoped we could talk it into reason,
m200570.諸々のことを終えてしっかり償ったら、\n海で思いっきり遊ぶんだって、楽しそうに話:
It seems that once she has finished making amends,
she plans to have her fill of fun in the sea. She was speaking quite cheerfully about it.
m200570.貴方の海で楽しみたいという願い自体は、\n悪いものではないと思いますから。:
I don't think your wish to enjoy the sea is
a bad thing in itself.
m200570.貴様らを倒して、安寧の海を手に入れるとしよう。: We will defeat you and reclaim a peaceful sea.
m200570.青い海だ……まだスライムになっていない海だ……！\n人間共を追い出し、このあたり:
The blue sea…… the sea before it became slime……!
Drive out the humans and make this place our home again!
m200570.青い海で水遊び、か。: Playing in the blue sea, huh.
m200570.順を追って説明しますね。\nまず私が作ったのは、水をスライムに変える装置。\n名:
Let me explain step by step.
First, I created a device that turns water into slime.
I named it the Slime Mass Production Device.
m200570.髪にも絡みついてるし……はぁ。\nこれ、ちゃんと取れるかな……。:
It's even tangled in my hair… ugh.

I wonder if I can get it all off…
m200570.魔物だってお洒落くらいするぜ。\n俺も帽子を被ってるわけだし。:
Even monsters like us can have a sense of style.
I'm wearing a hat, after all.

m320174.――あっ！？ そうだ、王子！ いいことを思いついたぞ！\n折角こうして出会えたの: —Ah! That's right, Prince! I've got a great idea! Since we finally met, why not spar with us? I think it would be good training for you all…?
m320174.――え！？ 指月伏見城さん！\n私たちの世界に帰らないつもりなのですか！？: —What!? Shizukizuki Fushimi Castle! Are you planning not to return to our world!?
m320174.――こういうことだよ、アンナー！\nスイたちねぇ、おっきくなれるんだよー。: —That's how it works, Anna! You see, we can get huge!
m320174.…………おお、そうか。\n我らの申し出を快諾してくれるとはな。\nふふ、感謝する: …Ah, I see. You'll gladly accept our proposal. Heh, thank you, Prince.
m320174.……王子。\n此度の饗応に対し改めて礼を言うぞ。異世界の者達との\n会食というこ: …Prince. I want to thank you again for this banquet. Perhaps because it's a dinner with people from another world, my lord seems especially delighted.
m320174.あ、あの……手合わせに関して異論はないのですが、\nまさか皆さんだけで我々の軍と: Um… I have no objection to the spar, but are you really going to have just you all face our army?
m320174.きょ、巨大化？\nあの、それは一体どういう……。: G-giant…? Um, what does that even…?
m320174.こほっ、こほっ……確かに、王子のお仲間の皆さんは、\n先の戦において巨大兜とも渡: Koh… koh… Indeed, the Prince's companions fought toe-to-toe with the Giant Helmet in the previous battle.
m320174.そうじゃなぁ……アンナたちは美しい上に優しそうじゃし、\n妾を三食昼寝つきで超絶: That's right… If Anna and the others are beautiful and seem kind, and promise to pamper me with three meals a day and naps, then maybe I could stay here forever~♪
m320174.それでは、食事会が終わり次第、\n手合わせの準備を進めるとしましょうか。: Then, as soon as the banquet ends, shall we proceed with preparations for the spar?

m320174.どうだ、王子？ 見ての通り、我ら城娘は\n斯様に肉体を巨大化させることが出来るの: Purple Forbidden City (giant): How about it, Prince? As you can see, we castle girls can enlarge our bodies at will.
m320174.どうだ王子、相手として不足はあるまい？: How's that, Prince? No shortage of opponents, I hope?
m320174.なるほど。城娘の皆さんとの軍事演習ということですね。\n異世界の戦術については私: I see. So a military exercise with the castle girls. I've been interested in other-world tactics for a while, so what do you think, Prince? May we have your permission?
m320174.ふむ、それについては我も気になっていた。\n人の身でありながら巨大兜と\n同等に: Hmm, that's been on my mind as well. To have a mortal possess power equal to the Giant Helmet… truly fascinating.
m320174.またそうやって、妾を働かそうとして……。\nそんなに戦力が欲しいなら王子軍の\n: You keep trying to make me work… If you need that much manpower, just take the Prince's strong comrades with you, okay?
m320174.むふふ♪ それに此方の食事はなかなかに美味ゆえ、\n甘味を制覇するまでは元の世界: Mufufu♪ And the food here is so delicious that I don't even want to return to my original world until I've conquered all the sweets. …Honestly, going back from here is such a hassle.
m320174.わ、分かりました……それでは王子\n食事会が終わり次第、\n我々も手合わせの準備: I… understand. Then, as soon as the banquet ends, we'll get ready for the match!
m320174.心配は無用です……こほっ、こほっ……。\n城娘6人だけであろうと、巨大化さえすれ: No need to worry… koh… Even with just six castle girls, if we enlarge ourselves, we'll have no shortage of strength against the Prince's forces.
m320174.故に、寡兵であろうと巨大化した城娘が6人もいれば、\n王子たちの軍とも対等に戦う: So even with a small force, six of us enlarged can stand toe-to-toe with your army.
m320174.馬鹿なことを言うでない、指月伏見城。\nぐーたらな其方であろうと大事な戦力ゆえ、: Don't speak such nonsense, Shizukizuki Fushimi Castle. Even if you're lazy, you're an important asset, so we won't allow you to wander off on your own.

m400157.……と、こんなところか。では共に行こう、王子。\n世の希望として、まずは入り江に: …That's about it. Come with me, Prince. As the world's hope, let's restore peace to the cove first. Let's start the Grand Annihilation Mission!
m400157.……ふむ。入り江の見取り図を確認するに、\n敵の侵攻が予想される箇所は複数存在す:
…Hmm. Looking at the cove's layout, there appear to be multiple points where enemy incursions are expected.
In other words, there are several defensive positions. Stay alert.
m400157.『大討伐ミッション』では1体でも多くの敵を倒す、\nそれだけが目的だ。: In a Grand Annihilation Mission, the only objective is to defeat as many enemies as possible.
m400157.『援軍要請』スキルを持つメンバーやワルキューレを\n編成に入れるのを忘れないよう:
Make sure to include members with the “Call Reinforcements” skill or Valkyries in your lineup.
…Hehe, you might not need this briefing, but the basics are important.
m400157.お目に掛かれて光栄だ、王子。私の名はイブキ。\n私の国にまで武名が響いていた偉大:
It's an honor to meet you, Prince. My name is Ibuki.
To be asked for assistance by a great prince whose fame has even reached my homeland—truly the height of honor.
m400157.それから、船の移動に狭い足場。\n行軍にも部隊展開には不都合な戦場だ。\n時間経:
Also, the ship's movement is limited by narrow terrain—unsuitable for marching or deploying troops.
The deployment cost won't recover over time, so keep that in mind.
m400157.たとえ拠点に攻め込まれライフが0となっても\nそれまでの討伐数を戦果としてクリア:
Even if your base is overrun and your life reaches zero, the number of enemies you've slain counts toward victory.
So focus on the hunt without fearing injury.
m400157.また、敵を倒してもEXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品の獲得は期待できない。\n『大:
And even if you defeat enemies, you won't earn EXP, gold, or drops.
Those are the key points for a Grand Annihilation Mission.
m400157.今は亡き祖国の名誉と誇りに懸けて、\nキミの協力要請に応えてみせよう。:
In the name of my late country's honor and pride,
I'll answer your call for help.
m400157.優に100を超える魚人の群れ。普段よりも大規模な\n魚人との戦いを想定したキミは: Over a hundred merfolk, a sizable horde. Expecting a larger-than-usual battle, you've asked me, a sailor, to support your naval operations.
m400157.報告によれば敵は群れて行動しているらしい。\n範囲攻撃が可能な人員が作戦成功の要:
Reports say the enemies move in packs.
Units with area-of-effect attacks might be crucial to success.
m400157.我々が才幹を持ってキミの軍を支援させてもらうよ。\nさて、今回のミッション形式は:
We'll lend our expertise to aid your forces.
Now, this mission is a “Grand Annihilation Mission,” with enemy elimination as the primary goal.
m400157.戦場の注意点としては、今回の戦場は珊瑚礁の入り江。\n敵は半魚人や魚人の群れ。龍:
As for the battlefield, it's the coral reef cove.
The foes are half-merfolk and groups of merfolk, with reports of a dragon's presence.
m400157.最後に、航海士が気にしていたんだが、\n魚人達が流木を運ぶ不穏な動きをしていたら: Finally, the navigator mentioned that the merfolk were oddly hauling driftwood around—like they're up to something.
m400157.状況の確認だが、キミの国にある入り江の一つ……\n珊瑚礁の入り江に魚人たちが集結:
Let's review the situation: one of the coves in your land—the coral reef cove—has become a gathering point for the merfolk.
I've heard those merfolk are trying to summon a dragon.
m400157.私のような水兵は常から対魚人用の訓練を行っている。\n練度の高い水兵を取り立てれ:
Sailors like me are constantly trained for anti-merfolk combat.
If you field highly skilled sailors, they'll surely prove useful—keep that in mind when forming your team.

m400264.――え、えっと、帝国天馬騎士の\nクラーラです！ し、失礼いたしましゅ！！: ――Um, uh... I'm Clara, Imperial Pegasus Knight! I—I'm sorry!!
m400264.……あ、ありました！ えっとですね、\n大討伐ミッションは『敵を撃破すること』\: Ah, here it is! The mission's primary objective is simply to “destroy the enemies.”
m400264.……えっと、王国へと接近している\n飛行型魔物の群れの対策に、\n帝国の飛空船を: ...Um, regarding the request to use an Imperial airship to deal with the swarm of flying monsters approaching the kingdom...
m400264.……こちらについて、\n帝国から正式に許可がおりましたので、\nその事をお伝えに: ...We've received official permission from the Empire, so I've come to tell you.
m400264.……との事です！ 良かったぁ、\n噛まずに言え…………ってあぁっ、\nもう一枚メ: …That's what they said! Phew, I managed to get through without stumbling… Oh! I have another note!!
m400264.『全く、やすやすと貸せる代物ではないのだがな。だが\n王国に倒れられても困る、今: “Honestly, it's not something we can just lend out easily. But we can't have the kingdom fall, so we'll make an exception this time,”—that's Lady Leona's words.
m400264.えっと、王子様、よく聞いてくださいね。\n今回の戦いは敵を倒すことだけを目的とし: Prince, please listen carefully. This battle is a “Grand Annihilation Mission” whose sole purpose is to defeat the enemies.
m400264.さらに、強大な魔物も含めすべての魔物を\n完全に討伐できれば、通常の１.５倍もの: Moreover, if we completely wipe out every monster, including the mighty one, it's equivalent to taking down 1.5 times the normal monster count…
m400264.す、すみません、噛んでしまいました。\nあぅ～……やはり、王子様の前では\n緊張: S-sorry, I bit my words. Ah... I really get nervous in front of you, Prince...
m400264.そのため出撃コストが時間経過で回復しないので\n『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ者や、: Because the sortie cost won't recover over time, be sure to include anyone with the “Call Reinforcements” skill and your cavalry in the deployment.
m400264.それほどに強大な魔物との戦いが、\n激戦となることは必至です。\nどうか慎重な采: A battle against such a formidable foe is bound to be fierce. Please command with caution!
m400264.ですので、自軍の被害を抑えるより\nいかに多くの敵を倒すかが重要です。: So it's more important to kill as many foes as possible than to minimize our own casualties.
m400264.また、ライフが０になってもクリアとなり、\nそれまでに倒した敵の数がカウントされ: Also, even if your life reaches zero, the mission is considered cleared, and the number of enemies you've slain will be tallied as your achievement.
m400264.もしも王国に向かっている魔物の群れが、\nこの強大な魔物の配下にあるとすれば、\: If the swarm heading toward the kingdom is under that monster's command, the whole group could be far tougher than we expected.
m400264.わ、わかりました、ではそのように\nお伝えしてまいります。それでは失礼し……って: Got it, I'll pass that along. …Excuse me—oh, sorry, I forgot to mention something important!
m400264.今回は飛空船上での戦いとなりますので、\n部隊が上手く展開できません。: This time the battle takes place on an airship, so your troops can't deploy normally.
m400264.偵察兵からのメモによると――\n強大な魔物が率いる群れを討伐することは、通常の１: According to the scout's notes—defeating a swarm led by such a mighty monster counts as defeating 1.3 times the usual number of monsters.
m400264.傷つくことを恐れず、一体でも多くの魔物を\n倒すことに専念してください。: Don't fear getting hurt—focus on taking down as many monsters as you can.
m400264.大討伐ミッションは通常のミッションとは\nいくつか異なる点がありまして。\n……: The Grand Annihilation Mission differs from regular missions in several ways… Let me see, I think I have a note here…
m400264.敵を倒してもＥＸＰやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはできませんので\n: Also, defeating enemies won't grant EXP, gold, or drops, so keep that in mind.
m400264.既に飛空船の配備は進めており、\nいつでも出撃は可能との事ですが。\n……え、準: The airships are already being deployed and are ready to launch at any moment. …So, if they're ready, does that mean we can go right away?
m400264.王子、お待ち下さい！\nたった今、偵察を行っていた兵より新たな伝令が。: Prince, wait! A fresh dispatch just came from the scouting troops.
m400264.王子様、どうかくれぐれも\n気を付けてくださいね……それでは、\n『大討伐ミッシ: Prince, please be extra careful… Now then, please issue the “Great Hunt Mission”!
m400264.矢を通さない硬質化したガーゴイルや、\n先に伝えた一つ目の魔物の青い個体等\n新: We've also found hardened gargoyles that arrows can't pierce, and the blue cyclops we mentioned earlier—new monster species seem to be appearing.
m400264.飛行型魔物の群れのさらに後方に\nとても強大な魔物の姿を確認したとのことです。: They've confirmed a tremendously powerful monster further behind the flock of flying monsters.
m400264.魔物の中には、普段はあまり見かけない\n一つ目の魔物の群れも確認されています。\: Among the monsters, there are some you don't usually see—a flock of cyclops has even been confirmed. Be careful not to be thrown off by their irregular movements.
m400264.魔物達を指揮しているのは、雷を操る\n巨躯の魔物とのこと……報告は以上となります: The ones commanding the monsters are said to be massive beasts that wield lightning… That's all for my report. …Phew, I finally managed to say everything without stumbling!!

m400291.それではこれより、\n『大討伐ミッション』を開始いたします！: Now then, let's begin the “Grand Annihilation Mission”!
m400291.だからこそ、今再びの大演習なのです！: That's precisely why we need another grand exercise now!
m400291.つまり、自軍の被害を抑えるよりも\nいかに多くの敵を倒すかが重要となります。: In other words, minimizing your own casualties matters less than racking up as many kills as possible.
m400291.ですが、新たなる力の獲得は、\n同時に新たな災いの源ともなります。: But gaining new power also brings new sources of trouble.
m400291.ですので、『援軍要請』のスキルを持つ兵士や、\n出撃コストを増加させる能力を備え:
Therefore, I recommend adding soldiers with the “Request Reinforcements” skill,
and Valkyries equipped with abilities that increase deployment cost,
to your deployment team.
m400291.では今回の演習の説明をさせていただきます。: Allow me to explain this exercise.
m400291.どうでしょうか……王子？\n異論は……ありませんか？: What do you think, Prince? Any objections?
m400291.まず、今回の演習では、\n『大討伐ミッション』\nという演習方式をとらせていただ: First, we'll be using a “Grand Annihilation Mission” format for this drill.
m400291.まず大討伐ミッションは\n『敵を撃破すること』\nそれだけが目的となります。: Its sole objective is simple: defeat the enemies.
m400291.また、大討伐ミッションでは\n出撃コストは時間経過では回復しませんので、\nその: Also, in a Grand Annihilation Mission, deployment costs don't recover over time, so careful team composition and command are essential.
m400291.もちろん、\n我が軍も成長していることは間違いありません。: Of course, our army has grown as well—there's no doubt about that.
m400291.ライフが0になってもクリアとなりますので、\nそれまでに倒した敵の数は全てカウン: Even if your life reaches zero, the mission counts as cleared, and every enemy you've slain up to that point is tallied as your final result.
m400291.互いに仲間であることを再認識し、\n同じ志の許に集ったのだという結束力を高めるこ: By reaffirming our bonds as comrades, strengthening the unity that brought us together under a common cause, we aim to improve coordination and boost our overall strength.
m400291.今はまだ何も起きていませんが、新兵の流入や、\n山賊海賊といった方々の素行や心構: Nothing's happened yet, but we have plenty of concerns: the influx of fresh recruits, the lax attitudes of bandits and pirates, and unseen tensions between different species.
m400291.今後、これまでよりも更に激しく\n困難な戦いが私達を待っていることは明白です。: It's clear that even harsher, more difficult battles lie ahead of us.
m400291.大討伐ミッションは、\n通常のミッションといくつか異なる点がありますので、\n注: The Grand Annihilation Mission differs from regular missions in several ways, so please pay close attention.
m400291.実りのある演習となることを、\n心から願っています。: I sincerely hope this drill will be fruitful.
m400291.最後に、敵を倒してもEXPやゴールド、\nドロップ品を手に入れることはできません:
Finally, keep in mind that even if you defeat enemies, you won't receive any EXP, gold,
or any drops—so please watch out for that.
m400291.様々な種族や生い立ちを持つ者から、\n多種多様なスキルと武具を操る方々が仲間とな: Allies from all sorts of races and backgrounds, wielding a wide variety of skills and weapons, have joined us, making our forces far stronger than we ever imagined not long ago.
m400291.無法者達への正規訓練の実施や、風紀の維持ならびに\n強化を意図した講習などは常日: We conduct regular training for the outlaws, maintain discipline, and hold reinforcement lectures, but that's not enough—more serious issues are looming.
m400291.王子……この度は、\n私からの急な申し出に賛同して頂き、\n本当にありがとうござ: Prince… Thank you so much for agreeing to my sudden proposal this time.
m400291.突然ですが王子、\n我が軍を総動員しての大演習の開催を進言します！: Prince, I have a sudden proposal: let's launch a massive training exercise, mobilizing all of our forces!
m400291.魔物たちは、以前に比べその数と強さを増し、\nあまつさえ戦術すら駆使する始末です: The monsters have increased both in number and strength since before, and they're even employing tactics now.

m400412.……んにゃッ？\n手伝う！？ 一緒に来てくれるのか？\nホントーだな？ ウソはキ: …Nya? Helping out? You're really coming with me? No lies, I hate lies!
m400412.あ、忘れるところだったぞ……あのな、敵を倒しても\nEXPやゴールド、ドロップ品: Oh, I almost forgot… even if you defeat enemies, you won't get EXP, gold, or any drops, so keep that in mind!
m400412.あれ？\nアタシ、なんでこんなこと喋ってるんだ？\nえーっと、もっと大事な何かを: Huh? Why am I saying this? …I feel like I was trying to tell you something more important…
m400412.うぅーッ！！ どうすればいいんだ！！\n考えたりするのはキライだぞ！ 今はとにか: Ugh!! What should we do!! I hate thinking about it! Right now we just have to neutralize the beasts and restore the forest's peace!
m400412.うぶるるる……いっぱいの魔獣と戦うのかと思うと、\nなんだか身体がぶるぶるってな: Ugh… just thinking about fighting a ton of beasts makes my body all jittery…
m400412.そうだ！\n魔獣の森が大変なんだぞッ！\n森の魔獣達がとつぜん暴れだしたみたいな: Right! The Beast-Forest is in trouble! The forest beasts have suddenly started rampaging.
m400412.それなのに、魔獣が暴れだしたっていうことは……、\nもしかしたら森の魔物使いに何: So the fact that they're rampaging means… maybe something happened to the forest tamers. I'm worried…
m400412.だから、ライフが0になってもクリアになるんだぞ。: That's why you can clear it even if your life hits zero.
m400412.だから自分達の仲間の被害を抑えるよりも、\nどれだけたくさんの敵を倒せるかってい: So it's more important to rack up kills than to protect our own allies.
m400412.だけどな、今回の戦いは出撃コストが時間経過で\nは回復しないから注意が必要なんだ: But watch out—this mission's deployment cost doesn't recover over time.
m400412.はぁ、なんだかしゃべりすぎて疲れたぞ……。\nもー説明はおしまいだぞ！: Ha, I'm exhausted from talking so much… That's all the briefing!
m400412.ほらー、はやく行こーよ？\nそうそう、アタシと一緒に\n魔獣たちを倒して森を静か: Come on, let's go already! Right, let's team up and clear out those beasts to quiet the forest!
m400412.もしアンタがやられちゃっても、それまでに倒した敵の数も\nカウントされて戦果とし: Even if you get taken out, the number of enemies you've defeated up to that point still counts toward your record, so just focus on slaying as many as you can!
m400412.やっっったぞーッ！\n噂どおりのいいヤツだな！\nよーし、そうと決まれば早速森へ: We did it! Just like the rumors, you're a great guy! Alright, now that it's decided, let's head to the forest!
m400412.ん？ どんなヤツか、だって？\nんーとね、獣人で、狩猟が得意で、あとはなぁ……\: Huh? You want to know what I'm like? Well... I'm a beast-person, good at hunting, and… Ah! I'm terrible with shoes, so I never wear them! Yeah!
m400412.アンタと一緒ならたくさん頑張れる気がするぞ！\n仲間たちとも協力して、一体でも多: With you by my side, I feel like we can really push ourselves! Let's team up with the others and take down as many enemies as possible. I can't wait to see who slays more!
m400412.人間なんか餌のひとつくらいにしか考えてないんだぞ。\nそれを森の魔物使いが大人し: They only see humans as a snack. The Beast-Tamers kept them under control, but…
m400412.今回の戦いは、とにかく敵をたくさん倒すことを\n目的とした『大討伐ミッション』な: This battle's goal is simple: a “Grand Hunt Mission” where we just kill as many enemies as possible.
m400412.倒すことに夢中になって部隊をどんどん展開して\nいくと、戦況が急に変わったときに: If you keep pouring units into the fight, you might not have any left to place when the battle suddenly shifts, so be careful about that.
m400412.大討伐ミッションていうのはだな、\n通常のミッションとはいくつか違う点が\nある: A Grand Hunt Mission differs from a normal mission in several ways, so you should be careful.
m400412.大討伐ミッションの最大の目的はだな、\nずばり『敵を撃破すること』なんだ！: The main objective of a Grand Hunt Mission is, plain and simple, “defeat the enemies”!
m400412.怖いのか……だって？ ち、ちがうぞ！\nこれはワクワクの前のゾクゾクだ！\n大事: Scared? N-no way! This is the thrill before the excitement! It's normal to feel like this before an important battle!
m400412.普段は魔物使いが森の魔獣たちをぜーんぶ管理して、\n悪さしないようにしてるんだ。: Normally the Beast-Tamers manage all the forest beasts and keep them from causing trouble.
m400412.最近じゃ、この近くの森にも魔獣がちらほら姿を\n見せるようになったし、もしかした: Lately even the nearby woods have been seeing beast sightings now and then, maybe they're being controlled by the beasts…
m400412.準備はいいか？ いいよな？\nよーし、それじゃあ\n『大討伐ミッション』の始まり: All set? You are, right? Alright, then… the Grand Hunt Mission begins!
m400412.王子！ 一緒に森にきてくれよ！\nアタシ聞いたんだぞ！？\n王子はスゴく強くて、: Prince! Come with me to the forest! I heard it! They say you're super strong and kind to beast-people!
m400412.知ってるか？\n魔獣っていうのは、そもそも、とっても凶暴な獣たちなんだ。: Did you know? Beast-beasts are inherently extremely ferocious.

m400534.――鋼の都の水道にスライムが湧いてるって？: So slime's sprouting up in the Steel City's waterworks?
m400534.あと地下には金目の物なんて全然ないですから、\n残念ながらEXPもゴールドも手に: Also, there's nothing valuable down there, so unfortunately you won't get any EXP or gold!
m400534.うげぇ。最近はずっと王国にいたから知らなかったけど、\n鋼の都って今そんなことに: Ugh. I've been in the kingdom lately, so I didn't know—so the Steel City is like this now...
m400534.ええと、王子は助けるつもりみたいですし、\n王国としても鋼の都の一大事を見過ごし: Well, the Prince seems intent on helping, and the kingdom won't turn a blind eye to this crisis in the Steel City.
m400534.このままではスライムたちが地上まで来てしまいます……。\nいえ、その前に地下水道: If this continues, the slimes will reach the surface... Actually, before that, the control machines for the sewers might be destroyed, cutting off water supply entirely.
m400534.そうなったら鋼の都のみんなが、\n喉がカラカラになって干からびちゃいます！: If that happens, everyone in the Steel City will be left with parched throats, drying up!
m400534.そうなんですよー。最近なんだか水の出が悪いし、\n出てくる水がどろっとしてるって: Yeah, that's right. Lately the water's been weak, and the water that comes out is all sludgy, so I checked the underground sewers...
m400534.そしたら地下がスライムまみれで、\nとんでもないことになっていました……！: Turns out the underground's swarming with slime—it's a total disaster...!
m400534.それじゃ、鋼の都に向かおっか。\n『大討伐ミッション』開始だよ！: Alright, let's head to Steel City. The Grand Extermination Mission begins!
m400534.それとですけど、かなりの数の警備機械が\nスライムに取られちゃったので、\nもし: Also, a lot of guard machines have been taken by slimes, so they might launch an attack on you, Your Highness!
m400534.ただ戦場はスライムの巣食う地下水道になります。\n部隊の補給は難しそうなので、『: The battlefield will be the slime-infested sewers. Supplying our troops will be tough, so we'll need someone with a “Request Reinforcements” ability and perhaps to form a Valkyrie unit...
m400534.というわけで王子様、大変恐縮だが、\nスライム退治を手伝ってもらうわけにはいかね: So, Your Highness, we're terribly sorry, but could you lend a hand with the slime extermination?
m400534.なにが起こるか不思議ではない状況ですので、\nどうか万全の準備をお願いします。: Given the circumstances, it's no surprise something will happen, so please be fully prepared.
m400534.アイゼルフさん、そのフォローの仕方は、\nあんまり良くないんじゃないかな……？: Izelf, that kind of self-praise isn't really… not very appropriate, you know?
m400534.拠点のライフが0になった場合でも、\nそれまでの討伐数が記録として残りますので、: Even if the base's life hits zero, the number of slimes you've taken down will still be recorded, so don't fear falling—stand up to the enemy.
m400534.王子、鋼の都を救うため、\n『大討伐ミッション』の発令を進言します！: Prince, to save the Steel City, I propose we issue a “Grand Extermination Mission”!
m400534.目的は地下水道に発生したスライムを、\n一体でも多く倒すことです。: The goal is to defeat as many slimes as possible in the underground sewers.
m400534.私たち警備隊がもう少し上手く立ち回れていれば、\nこんな危機的状況になることもな: If our guard had maneuvered a bit better, we wouldn't be in such a dire situation...
m400534.警備隊のみんなは最善を尽くしてましたよ！\n悪かったのはスライムを食い止めるバリ: The guard did their best! The only fault was me, the especially incompetent one who couldn't even set up a single barricade to stop the slime!
m400534.鋼の都警備部隊で駆除できたら良かったのですが……。\n数が尋常ではなく、僕たちの: We wish the Steel City Guard could've handled it... but the numbers are beyond normal, and we can't manage them.

m500288.――三本目の剣は、それを手にするに相応しい、\n正しき願いと強大な妖力を持つ者で:
――and the third could only be found by one who possessed
a righteous wish and immense yōkai power.
Even its location was hidden from all others!
m500288.――大嶽丸様、ここで滅ぶは得策ではありませんよ。\n落ち延びれば次の戦いが、その:
Four Heavenly Kings of Heavy Water: —Lord Otakemaru, perishing here is no wise course.
If we retreat, the next battle, and the one after that,
will wait for us forever!
m500288.――王子、緊急事態だ！\n大嶽丸が堂々と姿を現しやがった！:
――Prince, it's an emergency!
Otakemaru has shown himself in broad daylight!
m500288.……いつか大嶽丸のような鬼が現れた時に、\nそれを討つ偉大な妖怪が\n剣を抜ける:
……Right. The story went that if an oni like Otakemaru ever appeared,
a great yōkai would be able to draw the sword
and defeat him.
m500288.……わかったですぽん！\n「三明剣の長持」から封印の力を剥ぎ取って、\n防護の力:
……I see, popon!
He's stripped away the sealing power from the “Sanmei Sword Coffin”
and is abusing only its defensive properties, popon!!
m500288.……ククッ、これまではそうだっただろう。\n酒呑童子も人に討たれたのだからな。:
……Kukku. That was true in the past, I suppose.
Even Shuten-doji was slain by humans, after all.
m500288.……消え、た？\nおいスズネ！ 鬼はどこへ行ったんだ！？:
…Did they… vanish?
Hey, Suzune! Where did the oni go?!
m500288.……鬼の手によって、\n三明剣の封印が破られたということですか？:
……You mean the seal on the Sanmei Swords
has been broken by the oni?
m500288.あん……？ 何だあの箱は。\n大嶽丸のやつ、三明剣を箱に隠しやがったぞ？:
Hnn? What's that box?
Otakemaru hid the Sanmei Swords in it?
m500288.かつての力が蘇ってくる……。\nこれならば、畏れだ何だと言わず、\n全ての種族を:
The power of the past is returning…….
With this, it may not be impossible
to subjugate every race, fear be damned.
m500288.くぅっ……あと一太刀で死ぬような状態で、\nいったい何を面白がっているのですかね:
Four Heavenly Kings of Heavy Water: Grrr… In a state where one more strike will kill us,
what exactly is so amusing to you?!
m500288.くっ……このまま続けたら、\n本当に滅んでしまいますよ……！！:
Four Heavenly Kings of Heavy Water: Grrr… If we keep this up,
we're really going to be destroyed……!!
m500288.けっ、それなら剣を叩き折ってやればいいのさ。\n大嶽丸が血眼になって剣を探してた:
Tch. Then we'll just smash the swords to pieces.
If Otakemaru was desperate enough to hunt them down,
that means he's not invincible without them, right?
m500288.これからも化け化け情報網で、\n鬼の情報はしっかり探りますぽん！\nでも、まずは:
We'll keep using the Yokai information network
to track any news of the oni, popon!
But first—
m500288.さぁ、お前達の恐怖の色を、\n我ら鬼に味わわせてもらおうか……。:
Now then, let us savor
the color of your terror,
you humans……
m500288.さぁ王子よ、我が身が滅びるその瞬間まで、\n永久に殺し合おうぞ……！！:
Now then, Prince. Let us kill each other
until the very moment my body perishes……!!
m500288.さて、まずは何を砕いてやろうか……。\n重水の、お前ならば何処を蹂躙せんと望むか:
Now then, what shall I crush first……?
Heavy Water, where do you wish to trample?
m500288.しかし……あの男のことだ。\nきっと今に、この場所へ自ら殺されに来ることだろう。:
But…… that man.
I bet he's coming here right about now,
seeking his own death.
Kukku…… Come, Prince.
Hurry up and come to me……
m500288.しかし、封印の力を無理やり破壊した反動でしょう、\n箱自体の妖力も徐々に弱まって:
However, the backlash from forcibly breaking the seal
seems to be weakening the box's own demonic power.
We should find a way through soon!
--- scene: Lv.10 (battle, end) ---
m500288.そうです、ようやく三明剣を手にしたというのに、\nここで鬼が人に負けてなるもので:
Four Heavenly Kings of Heavy Water: Indeed. We've finally laid hands on the Sanmei Sword,
and now you expect an oni to lose to a human?
m500288.そうですね……。\n我ら鬼が幾度も煮え湯を飲まされた、\n王国の領土を平らげてや:
Well…….
I'd like to level the kingdom's territory,
the place where we oni have been boiled in scalding water so many times…….
m500288.そのとおり。\nいつの世も、鬼の行く先を制すのは人なのよ。:
Exactly.
In every age, it is humanity that holds the oni in check.
m500288.たしかにですぽんー！\nたぬぬっ！ 活路が見えてきましたぽん！:
That's right!
Tannnn! I see a way through!
m500288.たぬぬぬ……。\n二本の剣は妖怪の一族が代々守護し――:
Tannnn…….
The first two swords have been guarded by the yōkai clans for generations――
m500288.だが、これからは違う……。\nこれより先の世は、鬼が恐怖によって君臨するのだ。:
But that changes now.
From this point on, the oni shall reign
through the power of terror.
m500288.ですが、大嶽丸はほぼ死に体。\n三明剣を打ち破り、大嶽丸を瀕死に追いやった、\n:
However, Otakemaru is on the brink of death.
We broke the Sanmei Sword and left him near death,
so the oni won't be causing trouble for a while.
m500288.でも、伝承どおりの力を持っているのなら、\n三明剣の加護を受けた大嶽丸には、\n:
But if he has the full power of the legends,
Otakemaru, blessed by the Sanmei Swords,
is said to be untouchable…….
m500288.ぽぽん……おそらく妖術の類で、\nどこか遠方へ転移したみたいですぽん……。:
Popon… It looks like they used some kind of demon magic
to teleport somewhere far away, popon…
m500288.ぽぽん！ ついさっきあたし様の化け化け情報網にも、\n鬼の軍勢が現れたと報告があ:
Popon! My spy network just picked up a report
that an oni army has appeared!
m500288.ぽぽん！？\nあれってあたし様たちが封印に使っていた、\n「三明剣の長持」ですぽ:
Popon!?
That's the “Sanmei Sword Coffin”
we used to seal them in, popon!!
m500288.むぅ、しかしここで旅路が終わるのも、\n少々食い足りぬものがあるなぁ。:
Four Heavenly Kings of the Gale: Hmph. But having our journey end here…
It leaves a bit to be desired, doesn't it?
m500288.よし、そうと決まれば\n大嶽丸をぶちのめしに行こうぜ王子！: Alright, then let's go crush Otakemaru, Prince!
m500288.よし、王国に凱旋だな！\n鬼の被害にあってた村にも、\nこの戦果を報告してやろう:
Alright, let's return to the kingdom in triumph!
We should report our victory to the villages
that suffered from the oni's attacks!
m500288.クク……卑怯な手は人から学ばせてもらったぞ……。\n我が力を封じるなどという、\:
Kukku…… I learned that underhanded trick from you humans.
Sealing one's own power is
a dishonorable method for a warrior,
so I shall make use of it.
m500288.ククク……。\nやはり三明剣は、全て揃ってこそ輝きを増すものだ……。:
Kukuku…….
So the Sanmei Swords truly shine brightest when all three are together…….
m500288.クククッ！ これだ！ これを待っていた！！\n人の身で、鬼に抗う者を待っていた！:
Kukuku! This is it! This is what I was waiting for!!
I was waiting for one who would defy an oni
while still in human form!!
m500288.グハハハハ！！ 良いではないか！\n鬼とはどこまでも争いに生きるものよ！！:
Shunrai Four Heavenly Kings: Gwahahaha!! Not bad at all!
Oni are creatures who live for battle, after all!!
m500288.否、否だ重水の！\nこんなに愉快な戦いを止めるとは、\n武人としての名折れではな:
No, no, Heavy Water!
To stop such a delightful battle…
Is that not a disgrace to your name as a warrior?
m500288.封印が解かれてしまった以上、\nその原因を探るより、\nまずは大嶽丸を倒すのが先:
Now that the seal is broken,
we need to focus on defeating Otakemaru
before we can figure out how it happened!
m500288.平らげる、か……甘美な響きだ。\nかつての力を取り戻した今ならば、\n地平の果て:
To level it, huh…… What a delicious sound.
Now that I have regained my former power,
it is not beyond me to reduce everything to nothing,
all the way to the edge of the horizon.
m500288.愉快……実に愉快だ！！\nこの痛み、苦しみ、屈辱、これぞ真の闘争……ッ！！:
How delightful…… truly delightful!!
This pain, this suffering, this humiliation—
this is the true struggle……!!
m500288.正しき願いと、強大な妖力……。\n大嶽丸がそんなものを持っているとは思えないぜ。:
A righteous wish and immense yōkai power…….
I can't imagine Otakemaru having either.
He must have used some underhanded trick.
m500288.王子、これまでと同じとは思わない方が良いぜ。\nオレ達の全力で、あいつを叩き潰す:
Prince, don't assume this is like before.
We're going to smash that bastard to pieces
with everything we've got!!
--- scene: Lv.1 (battle, battle) ---
m500288.王子さま、「三明剣の長持」を破壊しない限り、\n中に隠された剣を折ることはできな:
Prince, unless we destroy the “Sanmei Sword Coffin,”
we can't break the swords hidden inside, popon!!
m500288.王子よ、この戦いは預けましたよ！\nこの屈辱、必ず……っ！\n必ずや、晴らさせて:
Four Heavenly Kings of Heavy Water: Prince, we leave this battle to you!
This humiliation… I will surely…
Surely, make it right!!
m500288.自分で剣を封印したってことか……？\nいや、それにしちゃ大嶽丸の気配が弱まってな:
So he sealed the swords himself……?
Wait, but Otakemaru's aura isn't getting any weaker.
m500288.見張り狸の報告では、間違いなく、\n大嶽丸は三本の剣を携えていたそうですぽん。:
According to the lookout tanuki, there's no mistake:
Otakemaru was carrying all three swords!
m500288.言い伝えでは、三本目の封印は\n決して破られないって聞いた覚えがあるんだが\nい:
I seem to recall the legends saying the third seal
was unbreakable.
How on earth did he get his hands on the last sword……?
m500288.誰が殺されに来るかよ。\n大嶽丸、倒されるのはテメェの方だぜ！:
Who's coming to get killed?
Otakemaru, you're the one who's gonna get crushed!

m500442.――あ、あの、その件でご報告が。: ――Ah, um, I have a report regarding that matter.
m500442.――その力は、怒りカ。\nソレホドまでに大切な民ナラバ、\n鳥籠にデモ閉じ込めて:
――That power…… is born of rage.
If they are truly such precious subjects,
then locking them in a birdcage and displaying them would be enough.
m500442.――それでは、始めます。\nレーヴちゃん、タイミングをあわせてください。:
――Then, let's begin.
Reve-chan, please synchronize with the timing.
m500442.――工業都市奪還戦、終結後: ――After the Battle for the Reclaiming of the Industrial City
m500442.…………そう、ですね。\n嘆いても被害が軽減されるわけではない。\n私たちが指示:
…………You're right.
Lamenting won't reduce the damage.
If we don't give orders, the soldiers can't move.
m500442.……いずれ、現実でもこうしてやろう。: ……Someday, I'll do the same to you in reality.
m500442.……そんなことが可能なのか？\n人間が神を目指すのに等しい行いだろう。: What Croco desperately seeks is likely to become one of those dragons.
m500442.……トドメは必要か？: ……Do you need me to finish you off?
m500442.……古代の雷竜、か。\n対抗策が必要だな。: It seems akin to a human attempting to become a god.
m500442.……感謝する。\n先ほどの激励は、効いた。:
……Thank you.
Your encouragement earlier hit home.
m500442.……揃いも揃って、\nいつまで「いかにも何か考えてます」\nみたいな顔して黙って: ……For all of you to stand there with that "I'm clearly deep in thought" look on your faces? How long are you planning to keep this up?
m500442.……記憶を再生します。\n工業都市奪還戦直後、竜将クロコを退けた時から――:
……Replaying the memories.
Immediately after the Battle to Retake the Industrial City, the moment we drove off Dragon General Croco――
m500442.『雷竜クロコ降臨』では、\n帝国ユニットの攻撃力、防御力が上昇します。\nさらに:
(narration): In 『Thunder Dragon Croco Descends』,
the attack and defense of Empire units increase.
Furthermore, the deployment cost of Empire units is reduced.
--- scene: Divine EX (battle, start) ---
m500442.ここから先は、夢の中に再現された戦場。\nその中で戦う皆さんからすれば、現実その:
From here on, this is a battlefield recreated within a dream.
To those fighting within it, the sights will feel entirely real.
m500442.そのために、クロコは\nハイドースに協力していたのかもしれません。: One whose name has even been lost to history: the Thunder Dragon.
m500442.その口、二度と利けぬようにしてやろう。\nまさか逃げるつもりはないだろう？:
I'll silence that mouth of yours forever.
You're not planning to run, are you?
m500442.その言葉、撤回できぬものと思え。\n行くぞ、竜将クロコ――！！:
Consider those words irrevocable.
Let's go, Dragon General Croco――!!
--- scene: Divine EX (battle, battle) ---
m500442.は、はいっ。\nジェニーさんに協力してもらって、\n竜人関連の古い記述を総当りし:
Y-Yes, sir.
With Jenny's help, I went through every old record I could find on Dragonkin.
m500442.むしろ制御できてない力の方が怖いですわ！\n王子さま、気をつけてくださいな！！:
Uncontrolled power is far more terrifying!
Prince, please be careful!!
--- scene: Divine EX (battle, end) ---
m500442.アンジェリーネ様、お言葉が過ぎます……！: My Lady Angeline, that was a bit too harsh……!
m500442.オヤメください！\nクロコ様、今のお身体デハ、\n雷竜の力に耐えきれマセヌ！！:
Please stop!
Croco-sama, your current body
cannot withstand the power of the Thunder Dragon!!
m500442.クロコが渇望しているのは、\nおそらくそのドラゴンの中のひとつ、\n名前すらも残: They were the first dragons, created by the ancestral Dragon Gods who are the ancestors of the Dragonkin of today.
m500442.クロコ様……いえ、竜将クロコ。\nなぜここまでして、雷竜を目指すのですか。:
Croco-sama… no, Dragon General Croco.
Why do you pursue the Thunder Dragon so relentlessly?
m500442.ハルモニア、カ……。\n竜ナラザルお前ニハ、理解ナドできまい……。:
Harmonia… K…
You, who are not a dragon… could never understand…
m500442.レオナ、都市の復興と同時に、\n軍主力での演習計画を立てろ。: Leona, alongside the city's reconstruction, draw up a plan for a full-scale military exercise.
m500442.不要、ダ。\n竜の世に、情けナド必要ナイ……。:
No… I don't.
Mercy has no place in the age of dragons…
m500442.人の世は終わらない。\n犠牲になった者たちの名は、\n未来永劫、この地の子どもた:
The human world will not end.
The names of those who gave their lives
will be passed down to the children of this land for all eternity.
m500442.今の時代の竜人たちに繋がる、\n祖たる竜神が生み出した、最初のドラゴンたち。: Dragons existed, beings that could be called natural phenomena themselves.
m500442.何かヒトツを過てば……世界ナド容易く滅ぶ……。\n人の世は終わる……ダガ、竜人、:
If even a single thing goes wrong… the world will be easily destroyed…
The human world will end… but the Dragon People…
m500442.偉そうな顔して黙ってるだけなら、\n白の帝国なんて早々に解体した方が良いですわね: If all you're going to do is put on that superior face and stay silent, we might as well dissolve the White Empire early.
m500442.全然力の制御ができてないみたいだけどね。: He doesn't seem to have any control over his power at all.
m500442.古の時代――人が今の時代ほど力を得ていなかった頃。\n自然現象そのものとも言える: In ancient times――when humans hadn't yet acquired the power they have now.
m500442.帝国兵全体の士気もあがることでしょう。\n士気の高さはそのまま、\n攻撃にも防御:
It should boost the morale of the entire imperial army.
High morale translates directly to both offense and defense.
m500442.弔い合戦の予行演習とは、腕がなるな。: A dress rehearsal for a battle of vengeance…… I'm itching to get in there.
m500442.悩む時間があるなら、\n今できることを考えなさい。: If you have time to worry, use it to think about what can be done right now.
m500442.構わヌ。\n遥かな高みに至ろうと言うノダ。\nこの命ナド、とうの昔に捨ててイル。:
I do not care.
I am aiming for heights far beyond reach.
I have long since discarded this life.
m500442.次の戦いで、クロコがその力を使ってこないとも限らない。\n俺たちでできることを、:
There's no guarantee Croco won't use that power in the next battle.
We want to do everything in our power to be prepared.
m500442.然り。こちらにも退けぬ理由がアル。\nいずれ終焉ヲ迎えるコノ大地で、\n竜神の血:
Indeed. I have my own reasons to stay.
On this land that will one day meet its end,
in order to preserve the blood of the Dragon Gods――
m500442.王国では、以前に夢の中で\nありえざる戦いの再現を試みていたな。: In the kingdom, you once attempted to recreate an impossible battle within a dream.
m500442.王国の書記官か。\n今は何でも情報がほしい。言ってくれ。:
The Kingdom's clerk, is it?
We need any information we can get right now. Tell me.
