I'm gonna make it look incredibly cool!
m900336.わぁぁあっ！？ そういうのはいいんだよ！\nまったく、勝利の余韻もあったものじゃ:
W-WHAT?! Don't say things like that!
Ugh, the victory's afterglow is completely gone.
m900336.ん、ありがとうレティシア。\n雷撃はかなり遠くまで届くからね、\n避難民の護衛も:
Mm, thank you, Leticia.
His lightning can reach quite far, so
are the evacuees being properly guarded?
m900336.んー……ほうほう……ほぇぇ……。\nふーん、ふんふん……おぉー。:
Hm~… oh, oh… ho~.
Hmm, mmm… oh.
m900336.ドゥンは雷に変化し、一瞬で別の場所へ転移する。\n……正直、これは嘘であってほし:
Dun transforms into lightning and teleports to another location in an instant.
……Honestly, I wish this were a lie.
m900336.ドゥンもあの場所に留まっていましたし、\n暴走していても、人類を守護した記憶は\:
Dun stayed in that location the whole time, so
even in his rampage, perhaps he still had some memory
of protecting humanity.
m900336.一番の功労者なんだから、\n誰も文句言わないと思うよ？:
You're the one who deserves the credit the most,
so I don't think anyone will complain, right?
m900336.今はおとなしくしている……というより、\nあの高台が気に入ったのかな……？\n戦:
He seems to be staying put for now…… or rather,
I suppose he just likes that high ground……?
It's a perfect spot for a battlefield.
m900336.大変なことっていうと、例えば……？: Out of hand, you say? Like what, for example?
m900336.異国では、今年はトラ年なんだっけ。\n新年早々イイことをしたんだ、\nきっと神獣:
In the foreign lands, this year is the Year of the Tiger, right?
We did something great right at the start of the new year.
It must be thanks to the Divine Beast Dun's blessing.
m900336.確かに、攻撃に耐えられる前衛担当が、\nドゥンを足止めして気を引きつけるしかあり:
Indeed. Our frontline units, who can withstand attacks,
will need to pin Dun down and keep his attention.
m900336.神獣ドゥンの加護を受けていると思うと、\nなかなか心強い装備なんじゃないかな？:
Knowing that you have the Divine Beast Dun's protection
makes it a pretty reassuring piece of equipment, don't you think?
m900336.神獣ドゥンの武具をまとう時には、\n称号を「雷虎を征す者」にすればいいからねー。:
When you equip the Divine Beast Dun's gear,
you can set your title to "Conqueror of the Thunder Tiger," you know~.
m900336.神獣ドゥンは、千年戦争当時に、\n魔王に対抗するため、\n天界から派遣されたとい:
The Divine Beast Dun is a powerful creature that,
during the Millennium War,
was said to have been dispatched from the heavens to oppose the Demon King.
m900336.貫禄抜群ねぇ……。\n本当は捕獲して、研究したいところだけど――:
He's got quite the presence……
I'd really love to capture him for research, but――

m920005.……もうあまり時間がございません。\n王子、共に参りましょう！: …We don't have much time left. Prince, let's go together!
m920005.ああ、追手がそこまで……\nもう逃げ切れない……: Ah, the pursuers have caught up... There's no way we can escape now...
m920005.あの小屋を目指しているようですね。\n何かあるのでしょうか？: They seem to be heading for that hut. I wonder what's there.
m920005.あの方は！\nああ…女神様の導きに感謝いたします。: That one! …Ah… I thank the goddess for her guidance.
m920005.あれは！竜人の兵士のようです。\nまだ生き残りが地上にいたのでしょうか。: Look! Those must be dragonfolk soldiers. There must still be survivors on the surface.
m920005.だからどうか王子、\n私に力を貸してはいただけないでしょうか……！\nもちろん案: So, Prince, could you lend me your aid? Of course, I'll be your guide.
m920005.ですが竜人の中にも、私のように人間と共存したい\n同志はいます！: But there are among us, like myself, who want to coexist with humans!
m920005.どうやら小屋の中に誰か隠れているようです。\n竜人たちは誰を追っていたのでしょう: Someone's hiding inside the hut. Who were the dragonfolk after?
m920005.むしろ今の私たちは、平和に人間の方たちと共存したいと\n願っているんです……。: In fact, we now wish to live in peace alongside humans...
m920005.今回、大長老が再び人間との戦いの命を下したとき、\n思わず私は地下から逃げ出して: When the High Elder once again ordered a war against humanity, I couldn't help but flee from the underground.
m920005.今地上では、各方面で一族たちが侵攻を進めています。\nまずはそこから食い止めなく: Right now, our clan is advancing on all fronts across the surface. We have to stop them first!
m920005.以前、私たち一族と戦われたことは存じております。\nですが、人間と私たちがいがみ: I know you've fought our clan before, but the enmity between humans and us dates back to a time long past.
m920005.助けていただいて、本当にありがとうございます。\n改めまして、私は竜人の巫女でエ: Thank you so much for rescuing me. Allow me to introduce myself properly—I'm Echidna, a priestess of the dragonfolk.
m920005.大長老は、私たち竜人一族の頂点に立つお方でございます。\nその方の命令には、誰も: The High Elder stands at the very top of our dragonfolk lineage. No one can defy his commands...
m920005.昔の人間との戦争を経験しているお方でもありますから、\nいまだ人間に恨みをお持ち: He's even lived through the ancient wars with humans, so he still bears a grudge against them.

m920032.……だが、それはあくまで目にかなえばの話だ。\n私の与える課題を乗り越えることが:
…but that's only if you meet my expectations.
If you can overcome the challenges I set, I'll acknowledge you as my lord.
m920032.ここから先は私も本気で戦わせてもらう。: From here on, I'll fight you seriously, too.
m920032.ここでは騎馬弓兵と戦ってもらう。\nだが、アーマーを出撃させることは禁止だ。:
Here, you'll face mounted archers.
However, deploying armor is prohibited.
m920032.この力は、私が認めた者の為に使いたい。\nこれからよろしく頼む、王子。:
I want to use this power for those I deem worthy.
From now on, I count on you, Prince.
m920032.さすが女神アイギスに選ばれたことはあるな……。\nこれまで目にした勇者の中でも群:
As expected of someone chosen by the goddess Aegis…
Your strength surpasses any hero I've seen.
m920032.だが、ただで協力するというわけにはいかない。\nその前にあなたの力がどれほどのも:
But I won't cooperate for free.
First, I want to see with my own eyes just how powerful you are.
m920032.だが足の速い騎馬部隊を近距離の兵士で\n止めることができないならどう戦う！: But if you can't stop fast cavalry with close-range troops, how will you fight!
m920032.なるほど……。\nこれ位はなんてことはないか。:
I see…
This is nothing special.
m920032.まさかここまでとは……。\nあなたの強さを認めざるを得ないようだ。:
I never expected it to go this far…
I have no choice but to acknowledge your strength.
m920032.今度は重装備の騎兵部隊が相手をする。\nただし回復することは禁止だ。:
Next, you'll face heavily armored cavalry.
But healing is forbidden.
m920032.先ほどと同じと思って侮らないことだな。: Don't underestimate it thinking it's the same as before.
m920032.先ほどは自己紹介もなく失礼した。\n改めて、私の名はエミリア。\n神の啓示を受け:
Sorry for not introducing myself earlier.
Allow me to start over: my name is Emilia.
I have come this far by divine revelation.
m920032.報告！ 砂漠に多数の騎兵部隊が\n出現しているもよう！: Report! A large cavalry force has appeared in the desert!
m920032.報告！ 魔物による襲撃です！ \nその数多数！:
Report! We're under monster attack!
They're swarming in large numbers!
m920032.女神アイギスに選ばれし王子とは\nあなたで間違いはないようだ。: It seems you are indeed the prince chosen by the goddess Aegis.
m920032.女神アイギスに選ばれたという\n王子の力を見極めに来た。: I've come to assess the prince chosen by the goddess Aegis.
m920032.戦乙女として数々の勇者を見てきた。\n私の目にかなう程の強者ならば\nあなたに仕:
As a war maiden, I've witnessed countless heroes.
If you're strong enough to meet my standards,
I'll serve you.
m920032.王子、向かってきます。\n迎え撃つしかないようです。:
Prince, they're coming.
It looks like we have no choice but to intercept.
m920032.王子、急ぎ迎え撃ちましょう！: Prince, let's rush to meet them!
m920032.砂漠で戦うとなると、兵士の体力が心配です。\nなにせ灼熱の地……。 \n王:
Fighting in the desert worries the soldiers' stamina.
After all, it's a scorching land…
Prince, please watch their endurance carefully.
m920032.私の騎馬部隊を相手にこれ程とは……。\nなかなかのやり手というわけか。:
Facing my cavalry to this extent…
You're quite the capable opponent.
m920032.私も魔物を倒すのを目的としている。\n故に同じ目的を有する王子に敵対する理由はな:
I, too, aim to slay monsters.
Therefore I have no reason to oppose a prince who shares that goal.
On the contrary, I'm willing to cooperate.
m920032.約束だ。\n最初に言った通り、王子に協力しよう。:
It's a promise.
As I said at the start, I'll cooperate with you, Prince.
m920032.近距離同士の真っ向勝負と\nいかせていただこう……！: Let's settle this with a close-quarters, head-on clash...!
m920032.通常、弓の攻撃は大盾と鎧で受けるのが有効……。\nしかしそれを封じた時、果たして:
Normally, a big shield and armor are effective against arrows…
But when that's taken away, let's see if you can still fight.
m920032.選ばれし王子、英雄の末裔……、\nどうやら肩書きだけではないらしい。:
Chosen prince, descendant of heroes…
It appears those titles aren't just for show.
m920032.防御の高い重装騎兵を相手に、\nどこまで耐える事ができるか見せてもらう。: Against high-defense heavy cavalry, show me how much you can endure.

m920114.――あら？\nここまで追ってくるだなんて、\nどうして生き埋めになっていないのか: ―Oh? You actually chased us all the way here. I wonder why you haven't been buried alive.
m920114.――あれが、女王様の言っていた王子なのね。\n思ったより悪くないじゃない。: —So that's the Prince the Queen mentioned. Not as bad as I thought.
m920114.――あれがジジィの言っていた王子たちか……。\nどうやら地雷には気付かれたみたい: ???: —So those are the princes the old man was talking about… Looks like they've noticed the mines, but if we give them an opening, we'll set them all off at once!
m920114.――いいえ、その目は本気みたいね。\nでも一人で行かせるわけにはいかないわ。\n:
—No, that look says you're serious.
But I can't let you go alone.
Prince, could you let this girl stay with the kingdom?
m920114.――いや、ちょーっと待った。\nこの辺り一帯が地雷原になってるぞ。:
—Hold on a sec.
This whole area's turned into a minefield.
m920114.――いや、噂をすればというやつだ。\n結構な数の魔物の気配がするぞ。: —Ah, speak of the devil. I can feel the presence of quite a few monsters.
m920114.――おぉ、マインここにおったか！\nまったく、あちらこちらと探し回ったぞ。: —Ah, there you are, Mine! I've been searching high and low for you.
m920114.――そう、メカゴブリンクイーンには\n逃げられてしまったのね……。: —So, the Mecha Goblin Queen got away…
m920114.――でも、もう手遅れなのよ。\nオォ～ホッホッホ！！: —but it's already too late. Ooo… hohoho!!
m920114.――なるほど、そんなことでお悩みでしたのね。\n心配はいりませんわ。\n女の子は:
――I see, that's what's been bothering you.
There's no need to worry.
Any girl can become a princess!
m920114.――否、魔物の討伐は順調に進み、\n主君らの手を煩わせる程ではありませぬ。: —No, the monster extermination is going smoothly, not enough to trouble our lords.
m920114.――大慌てで飛び出して行ったわね。\nありがとう。王子にだったら、\n安心して私: ―You rushed out in a panic. Thank you. If it's you, Prince, we can safely entrust our adopted daughter to you.
m920114.――王子様！ こっちです！\nこっちで女の子が、\nグレーターデーモンに襲われて: Prince! Over here! A girl is being attacked by the Greater Demon!
m920114.…………ありがと。\nその、お礼は言っておくわ、一応ね。: …Thanks. I'll say thank you, just in case.
m920114.…………ん？\nおいジジィ、ありゃ何だ？\nこんな洞穴見たこと無いぞ？:
………Huh?
Hey old man, what's that?
I've never seen a cavern like this.
m920114.…………何か可愛さとは違う、\n別のものを見つけてしまった気がしますわ。: ………I feel like I've stumbled upon something different from cuteness…
m920114.…………？\nそ、そうですわね、確かに強者は輝いて――: ………? Yes, that's right—indeed, the strong do shine—
m920114.…………？\nドレスが可愛いと、悔しいの？: ………? You're jealous because the dresses are cute?
m920114.……えっ？ 私の娘なのかって、\nち、違うわ！ 違うから！！: …What? You think she's my daughter? N-no! That's not true!!
m920114.……でも、こいつを倒すのに、\n手を貸してくれるっていうのなら、\nありがたく頼: …But if you'll lend a hand in taking this thing down, I'll gratefully accept your help.
m920114.……どうやら人間に敵意を持つ\n竜人たちの住処だったようですね。: …It seems this was the dwelling of the dragon-people who bear hostility toward humans.
m920114.……ふふっ、ありがとう王子。\nちなみにマインが採掘場への道案内をするから、\n:
…Hehe, thanks, Prince.
By the way, Mine will guide us to the mine, so please look after this kid too, okay?
m920114.……へへっ、ありがとよ、王子！\nそうと決まったら急いで準備してくるぜ！: …Heh, thanks, Prince! Now that it's decided, I'll hurry and get ready!
m920114.……よく分かりませんが、\nどちらもお怪我のないようにお願いしますね？: …I don't really understand, but please make sure neither of you get hurt, okay?
m920114.あ、それから王国に戻る時には一声かけてね。\n約束通り、前もって採掘していた分の: Oh, and when you head back to the kingdom, give me a heads-up. As promised, I'll bring the Floating Stones we mined earlier from the storage.
m920114.あぁら、何かと思えば侵入者さんね。\nでもあなたの相手をしている暇はないのよ。:
Ah, look who we have, an intruder.
But I don't have time to deal with you.
m920114.あぁん！？ そりゃいったいどういうことだ！: Ahh!? What on earth is happening!
m920114.あっ、おい待ちやがれ！\n空飛ぶなんて卑怯だぞてめぇーッ！！: Hey, wait up! Flying away like that's cheating, you bastard!!
m920114.あっ、待ってください。\n今傷を治しますから。\n少しだけ、じっとしていてくださ: Ah, wait! Let me heal your wounds. Just stay still for a moment.
m920114.あのような兵器に悪用するため、\nゴブリンたちは『浮遊石』を盗掘していたのですね: So the goblins were mining the Floating Stones to weaponize them… Prince, let's stop the goblins!
m920114.あれ？ お前ティニーとよくつるんでた――: Huh? You used to hang out with Teeny a lot—
m920114.あんたたち、スゴイんだな……。\nあんな大量の魔物をやっつけちまうなんて。: You guys are amazing… taking down that huge horde of monsters.
m920114.あんな崩落くらい楽勝だってんだ！\nさぁ『浮遊石』を返してもらうぜ！！: That kind of collapse is a piece of cake! Hand over the Floating Stones!
m920114.い、いや、気にすんなって！\n頼まれたからにはちゃーんと道案内するからさ。\nば:
N-no, don't worry about it!
Since you asked, I'll guide the way properly.
And I've got to apologize for almost blowing everything up…
m920114.いいえ、マインが謝る必要はないわ。\nこれは警備が手薄だった、\nドワーフの王国:
No, you don't have to apologize.
The guard was thin; it's the whole dwarf kingdom's fault.
m920114.いや、それでは時間が足らんじゃろう。\nどれ、ならばワシが壁を発破して――:
No, we don't have time for that.
Alright, let me blast the wall—
m920114.いや何、『浮遊石』鉱脈への、\n近道を作ってやろうかと思っての。\nこうして準備:
Well, I was thinking of making a shortcut to the floating stone vein.
That's why I've been prepping.
m920114.いや何、どうでもいいことさ。\nただちょっと、悔しかったっつーか……。: No, it's nothing. Just… I'm a bit frustrated, I guess.
m920114.いや待て！ ジジィってばアタシに、\n『王子たちを盛大に歓迎してやるのじゃぞ』っ: Wait a minute! That old man just told me, “Give the princes a grand welcome,” right a moment ago!
m920114.うぅ……そう、かな……？\nちったぁ役に立てたかな……？: Ugh… maybe…? I wonder if I was of any help…?
m920114.うぅ、飛び出して悪かったよ。\nごめん、このとおりだッ！: Ugh, sorry for rushing out. Here, take this!
m920114.うわぁ……ッ！？\nえっ、えっと、アンタは、\nいや、アンタたちはいったい……？:
W-what…!? Um, you…
No, who are you all…?
m920114.うわっ、うわぁあっ！？\nお、脅かすんじゃねぇよティニー！: W-what the—!? Don't scare me, Teeny!
m920114.えぇ、目的地までまだ距離がありますし、\nここからの旅路も頼りにさせていただきま: Yes, we still have a ways to go, and I'll rely on you for the journey ahead.
m920114.ええ、そうですね……！\n王子、マインさん、何としてでも、\nメカゴブリンクイー: Yes, that's right…! Prince, Mine, we must do whatever it takes to stop the Mecha Goblin Queen's escape!
m920114.お、王国に……？ いいのか……？: Oh, stay in the kingdom…? Is that okay…?
m920114.おぉおぉ、王子たちも来ておったか。\n出迎えにこやつを寄越したが、\nいつまで経: Oh, oh, the princes have arrived as well. I sent this one to greet you, but he never came back, so I got worried.
m920114.かしこまりましたわお母様。\n私たちの『トライアングル・フォーメーション』で、\:
Goblin Princess Eldest Daughter: Understood, Mother.
With our “Triangle Formation,” we'll dote on you to the max! Right, Third sister?!
m920114.きゃぁぁ！？\nか、壁が崩れて……けほっ、\n通路が塞がれてしまいました……！！:
Ahhh!?
The wall's collapsing… *cough*,
the passage is blocked…!!
m920114.くっ……。\nそ、それは……えぇと……ぐぬぬ……。: ???: Damn… It… it's… uh… gn… gn…
m920114.くっ、まさかこんなところで……。\n王子、急ぎ戦闘の準備をッ！！: Damn, I never expected this here… Prince, hurry and prepare for battle!!
m920114.ぐ、ぐぬぬ……ご、ごめんなさい。\nでも、悪いのは誤解を招く言い方をした、\nグ:
Guh, grr… s-sorry.
But the one to blame is Gustav's old man for saying it in a misleading way! Don't forget!
m920114.ぐ、偶然だし。偶然。\nティニーが目利きしてくれなかったら、\nあの鉱脈ごとふっ:
Ugh, it was just coincidence. Coincidence.
If you hadn't recognized it, we would've blown the whole vein away…
m920114.ぐっ……助かったわ……。\nそれじゃあ、アタシはもう行くから。: …Ugh… that was a close call… Well, I'm leaving now.
m920114.ぐぬっ、ゴブリンの手にそんな大量の\n『浮遊石』が渡ったら、\nどんな悪用をされ: Grr… If that many ‘Floating Stones' fall into goblin hands, who knows what they'll do with them…!?
m920114.ぐぬぬ、爆破しそうになったお詫びだ、\n仕方ないから案内くらいしてやるよ。\nそ:
Grr, consider this an apology for almost blowing you up.
Fine, I'll show you the way.
Um, uh, let's… work together again…?
m920114.けほっ、けほっ……。\nまったく、もうちょっとタイミングってものを……って、\n:
*cough* *cough*… Seriously, a little more timing would help…
Hey, don't say that!
m920114.けほっ、けほっ。\nあんにゃろう、この狭い空間に\nなんて量の爆薬を仕掛けてやが:
*cough* *cough*.
You idiots, planting that amount of explosives in such a cramped space…!
m920114.このままではマインさんが危険です！\nグスタフさん、マインさんの退避を\nお願い: Prince, Mine is in danger! Gustav, could you handle getting her to safety?
m920114.この借りは必ず返すから。\nあなた達が危機に陥った時は、\nアタシが助けにいくわ: I'll definitely repay this debt. If you ever find yourselves in trouble, I'll come to your aid.
m920114.この王国の職人皆が、\nあの子の親代わりみたいなものなの。\n一番目をかけてるの: All the craftsmen in this kingdom are like parents to that child. Gustav cares about her the most, though.
m920114.この辺にもいくつか、\n魔物の住処らしき場所があるんだ。\n気をつけて進まないと:
There are a few spots around here that look like monster dens.
We have to be careful as we move forward—
m920114.この通路、ゴブリン博士特製の爆薬で、\n爆破してやったらどうなるかしらねぇ！: I wonder what'll happen if I blast this tunnel with the goblin doctor's special explosives!
m920114.この遠吠え……地雷原だけでも大変なのに、\nいつの間にか狼の群れに囲まれているぞ: That howling… The minefield alone is a nightmare, and now we're surrounded by a pack of wolves.
m920114.これ、待つのじゃマイン！！\n策も無く飛び出しては――:

m920114.王子、マインさんの避難はグスタフさんに任せ、\nゴブリンプリンセスたちを止めまし: Prince, leave Mine's evacuation to Gustav and let's stop the Goblin Princesses! Please take command of the counterattack!
m920114.王子、地雷の設置場所に気をつけながら、\n魔物の群れを迎撃しましょう！: Prince, stay alert for the mines while we fend off the monster horde!
m920114.王子、地雷を操っていた工兵を捕まえたぞ。\n――おい、どうして地雷なんて仕掛けた: Prince, we've captured the engineer who was controlling the mines. —Hey, why did you set them up in the first place?
m920114.王子、奥へ逃げていった\nメカゴブリンクイーンを追いかけましょう！: Prince, let's chase after the Mecha Goblin Queen that fled deeper inside!
m920114.王子、安全確保の為にも、\n一度調査してはいかがでしょうか？: Prince, for safety, why don't we investigate it?
m920114.王子、機甲兵の中には自爆する個体もいます。\n十分に警戒して迎撃してください！:
Prince, some of those mech soldiers are suicide units.
Stay on high alert and intercept them!
m920114.王子たちなら、\nきっと有効活用してくれるでしょう？: Prince, I'm sure you'll put them to good use, right?
m920114.王子たちに助力を要請したのは、他でもないわ。\n新たな『浮遊石』の鉱脈が見つかっ: We asked the Prince for help because, well, we've found a new vein of “Floating Stone.”
m920114.王子たちに気付かれる前に、\n『浮遊石』を掘り尽くすのですわ！\n三女、あなたも:
Goblin Princess Daughter 2: Before the Prince notices, we'll mine out all the “Floating Stones”! 
Third sister, you say something too!
m920114.王子に小生意気な娘、\n確かにアナタたちには一杯食わされたわ。\nでもねぇ、勝っ: Prince, you have a cheeky daughter. Sure, you fed us a lot. But guess what? I won!
m920114.王子に街の案内してもらったんだけどさ、\n服飾店のドレス、可愛かったなぁって……:
The Prince gave me a tour of the town, and…
the dresses at the boutique were so cute…
m920114.申し訳ありません、王子。\nメカゴブリンクイーンの逃走を許した上、\n『浮遊石』:
I'm sorry, Prince.
We let the Mecha Goblin Queen escape, and most of the Floating Stones were taken.
m920114.盛大に、歓迎……？\nどうやら誤解があったようですね……。: A grand welcome…? It seems there's been a misunderstanding…
m920114.確かに、盛大な地雷原だったなぁ……。: It was certainly a grand… minefield.
m920114.私自らがアナタたちを足止めしていたと、\n気付かないのかしら、お馬鹿さぁん！ 『: Did you not realize I was the one holding you back, you fool! The units with the Floating Stones got plenty of time to escape.
m920114.穴の奥に見えるの……あれ機甲兵ですよ！: That thing we see deep in the hole… that's a mech soldier!
m920114.空が突然暗く……って、\nおい王子、向こうの空から何か来るぞ！:
The sky just went dark…
Hey, Prince, something's coming from over there!
m920114.色々な用途に使える便利な鉱石なんだけど、\nそれ故に、軍事転用を目論む者もいるの:
It's a handy ore with many uses, which is why some people want to weaponize it…
But with the kingdom, we can trust you, right?
m920114.行きの道中じゃ失敗しちまったけど、\nその埋め合わせをさせてほしい。\n今度は無:
I messed up on the way out, but let me make it up.
This time I'll carve a proper hole!
m920114.話してる時間は無いみたいだぞ。\n王子、早く戦闘準備を！: Looks like we don't have time to talk. Prince, get ready for battle!
m920114.足止めじゃと！？ ぬかったわ！\nメカゴブリンクイーン自ら時間稼ぎをするとは……: A blockade? I'm not falling for that! The Mecha Goblin Queen herself is buying time...!
m920114.頼むよティニー……アタシが、\n『浮遊石』を取り戻す旅に出るのを許してくれ！: Please, Teeny… let me go on a quest to retrieve the Floating Stones!
m920114.魔物の残党にも気をつけられよ。\n竜人族と戦うとなれば、\n新手の敵が現れるかも: Watch out for any remaining monsters. If we're to fight the dragon-people, a new kind of enemy might appear.
m920114.魔物も少なかったし、\nこれならすぐに到着できそうね。: There aren't many monsters, so we should be able to arrive right away.
m920114.（プリンセスだけじゃありません、\nあっちにいるのはメカゴブリンクイーンです！）: (It's not just the princesses; over there's the Mecha Goblin Queen!)

m920123.――あっ！ そうでしたね。\nあちらの子達とも遊んであげないと……。\nそれじゃ: —Ah, that's right. I should play with those kids over there, too… Well then, I'll be waiting deeper inside!
m920123.――あの結晶に『破滅の力』が宿っているのか。\nこれまで以上に強く、力の波動が感: ――So that crystal contains the “Power of Ruin.” I can feel its wave stronger than ever before.
m920123.――あら、あらあら？\nつまりあなたの身体が、\nもっといっぱいあれば良いのです: ——Oh my, oh dear? So you wish you had… more bodies, don't you?
m920123.――あん？ ……な、何だ？\nさっきまでは宝の山が見えてたのに、\n突然消えちま: ——Huh? …W-what? We just saw a mountain of treasure, and now it's vanished out of thin air?
m920123.――いえ、今回はそうでもなさそうです。\n砦を占拠されてはいますが、\nどうやら: —No, that doesn't seem to be the case this time. They've taken the fortress, but their hunger hasn't abated.
m920123.――うむッ。王子よ、お前のガッツに免じて、\nこの場は見逃してやろうぞ。\n更に: —Indeed. Prince, because of your guts, I'll let this slide. Sharpen your technique and come challenge me again!!
m920123.――おや？ この先でマンモンと戦っているの、\nもしやデシウスじゃないか……？: ——Oh? Fighting Mammon ahead… could that be Decius…?
m920123.――だがッ！！ もはや時代のスターは我であるッ！！\n時代遅れの旧幹部とその仲間: But! I am the star of this age! Those outdated former executives and their cronies think they can match me, bolstered by the kids' cheers? Don't be foolish!
m920123.――ちぃっ、瘴気のせいで身体が重いぜ。\nおいマンモン、本当に財宝を蓄えたドラゴ: —Ugh, the miasma makes my body heavy. Hey Mammon, there really is a dragon hoarding treasure around here, right!?
m920123.――ちょっとお待ちになって？\nまったく、今日は騒がしい来訪者が\n多すぎないか:
――Hold on a moment?
Goodness, there are far too many noisy visitors today… *sigh*… *cough*…
m920123.――どうやら、おふたりの予想が当たったようですね。\n王子、砦の入り口から敵が現: It looks like your guess was right. Prince, enemies have appeared at the fortress entrance. Prepare to intercept them immediately!
m920123.――ひぎっ……あ……あぁ……。\nわ、私が……負ける……なんて……。: —Hig... ah... ahh... I… I can't… lose… such…
m920123.――ふふっ、とうとう見つけましたよ？\n助けてくれた後、すぐに帰ってしまったので: —Heh, I've finally found you. After you rescued me and then left, I've been searching far and wide for your whereabouts.
m920123.――ほらほら、こっちですよ♪\n金銀財宝ざっくざく～♪: —Come on, over here♪ Loads of gold and treasure galore~
m920123.――やっぱり、付いてきたのですね。\n改めてようこそ、私の『迷宮アヴァリティア』: ——So you did follow after all. Welcome once more to my “Labyrinth Avalitia.” Since you're here, let me show you a glimpse of a demon god's power.
m920123.――んっ、『力』？ あっ、そうでした！\n魔王軍……？ の子達の相手もしてあげな:
――Hmm, “Power”? Ah, that's right!
The Demon King's army…? We have to deal with those kids too!
m920123.――シャディアよ、何か勘違いをしていないか？\nもはや我らは同胞ではないのだぞ？: —Shadia, aren't you misunderstanding something? We're no longer comrades now. Come on, Prince, Shadia, take up your weapons!!
m920123.――ムゥ、挑戦者と王者の戦いを邪魔するとは、\n如何に魔神マンモンとはいえ許され: —Muu, to interfere with a battle between challenger and king, even as the demon Mammon, is an unforgivable folly. Defile my ring, and you shall atone with death.
m920123.――待たせたな、挑戦者達よッ！！\n魔神との戦いは余興も余興、\nこれより始まる: ――Sorry to keep you waiting, challengers!! A fight with a demon god is just entertainment, and the final match starts now!!
m920123.――待てフィリス。\nようやく追いつけたのだから、万全の状態で進むべきだ。\n何: —Hold on, Phyllis. Now that we've finally caught up, we should move forward in perfect condition. After all, we have no idea what forces they have.
m920123.――未踏地域は魔界の者であっても\n踏み入るのを躊躇うような場所よ。\nけれどそ: —The uncharted region is a place even demons hesitate to step into. Yet it seems the Demon King's army has gone there.
m920123.――無論、魔王ガリウスを打倒するためだ。\n奴は物質界全体の消滅を望んでいるから: ――Naturally, to defeat the Demon King Garius. He wishes the entire material world to be erased.
m920123.――王子、斥候がこの先で、\nドラゴンの群れを発見したそうです！: ――Prince, the scouts say they've spotted a flock of dragons ahead!
m920123.――静かになりましたね。\n砦に籠もっていたヴァンパイアは、\n掃討出来たのでし: It's quiet now. Did we manage to clear out the vampires that were holed up in the fortress...?
m920123.――願望を映す鏡、か。\n仮に私達の願いが反映されたら、\n『迷宮アヴァリティア: —A mirror that reflects desire, huh. If our wishes were reflected, I wonder what “Labyrinth Avalitia” would look like.
m920123.…………やだ、ちょっと素敵じゃないですか？\nそれなら私も、さっきよりちょっと本:
……… How delightful, isn't it?
Then I'll step it up a bit from earlier.
Show me your aspirations and brilliance!
m920123.……あっ、また行ってしまいました。\n全然人の話を聞いてくれませんね……。: …Ah, she's gone again. She never listens to anyone…
m920123.……いや、あなたに願いを叶えられると、\nそのまま人は破滅の道を行くと聞く。\n: …No, they say anyone who gets a wish from you ends up on the path of ruin. Unfortunately, we don't have that luxury.
m920123.……いや、落ち着け。\nどこにそんな物があるんだ。: …Hold on. There's no way such riches exist here.
m920123.……おふたりがそこまで言うのなら、\nよほど深刻な事情があるようですね。\n王子: …If you both are that insistent, there must be a serious reason. Prince, shall we discuss the details after we've dealt with the monsters?
m920123.……けれど、相手はドラゴンです。\n何より魔界の瘴気の中での戦いですから……。\: …But the opponent is a dragon. And it's a fight in the demonic miasma… Please don't let your guard down, okay?
m920123.……ここは、まさか魔界のコロシアムか？\nそうか、マンモンの力が満ちた迷宮ならば: …This must be the Demon Realm's coliseum. So, if the maze is filled with Mammon's power, it can work even without the demon god himself.
m920123.……これは、王国……いえ、これはっ！\n私の……夢みた……。:
…This is the kingdom… no, this is it!
My… dream…like…
m920123.……そうだったな、デシウス。\n王子、デシウスを倒し、この先へ急ぐぞ！！: …That's right, Decius. Prince, defeat Decius and we'll hurry onward!!
m920123.……それは確かに。\nまた強敵が現れて、足止めをされては困ってしまうな。: …That's true. We can't have another tough opponent show up and stall us.
m920123.……だめ、だめですっ！\n過去を再現するためではなく、\n平和な未来を掴み取るた: …No, no! We're fighting not to recreate the past, but to seize a peaceful future!
m920123.……どうにか魔物を撃退できましたね。: …We managed to drive the monsters back, after all.
m920123.……な、何っ？\n魔神マンモンよ、それはいったいどういう――: …W-what? Demon Mammon, what on earth are you—
m920123.……なるほど、未踏地域までのゲートを開けるなら、\n瘴気に耐性の無い者でも行軍が: …I see. If you can open a gate to the uncharted region, even those without miasma resistance could march. Prince, please prepare for immediate departure!
m920123.……なるほどね、それは済まないことをした。\nだけどこれは……そそるねぇ。: …I see, that's something I shouldn't have done. But… it's tempting.
m920123.……はぁ、王子に他人を見捨てて目的を果たせ、\nとは言えねぇもんなぁ……。\nそ: …Sigh, I can't just tell the Prince to abandon others to achieve his goal… That's why I followed him.
m920123.……ほう、人間の身にして、\n我が渾身の一撃を受け止めるとはな。: …Hmm, to think a mere human can withstand my full-force strike.
m920123.……むぅ、確かに。\nよし、急いで準備を整えよう。: …Hmm, you're right. All right, let's hurry and get ready.
m920123.……むっ、その声は……シャディアか！？\nやはり魔神マンモンの言っていた\nもう: …Huh, that voice… Shadia? So the “other party” the demon Mammon mentioned must be you and the Prince…!!
m920123.……むむ、少し複雑ですが、\n感謝されるのは悪い気分ではないですね？: …Hmm, it's a bit complicated, but being thanked isn't a bad feeling, is it?
m920123.……やはり、ガリウスの手勢が先行していたか。\nマンモン……いや、魔神マンモンよ:
…So Garius's forces were indeed ahead.
Mammon… no, Demon God Mammon, could you let us pass?
m920123.……んー、あっちの子たちも中々。\nでも願いを叶えてあげたい感は、\nやっぱりあ: …Hmm, those kids over there are something else. Still, I'd rather grant wishes for those humans…
m920123.……ガオレオン、魔王軍、撤退していきます。\n『破滅の力』は……奪われてしまいま: …Gaoleon, the Demon King's army is retreating. The Power of Ruin… has been taken…
m920123.……ゲートの展開には膨大な魔力が必要なんだ。\n魔王ガリウスに力を奪われる前であ: …Opening a gate requires an enormous amount of magic. Before Garius stole our power, we could have wielded limitless mana.
m920123.……デシウス、\n何故私達に、そんなことを教えてくれるんだ？: …Decius, why are you telling us such things?
m920123.……待ってシャディア。\n瘴気に耐性のある者だけを連れていくべきよ。\n未踏地点: …Wait, Shadia. We should only take those resistant to miasma. Marching to the uncharted site would be impossible for humans—
m920123.……願望を叶えた幻か。\n厄介ではあるが、私達には無意味だろう。\n行くぞ王子、: …An illusion that grants wishes. Troublesome, but it means nothing to us. Let's go, Prince, and take Mammon down.
m920123.……魔物が迫っているだって？\nそれは想定外だな。おいジルヴァ、\nここは一度共: …Monsters are closing in? That wasn't in the plan. Zilva, why don't we team up first and drive them back, then…
m920123.……魔王軍が、近くにいるだって！？\nこうしちゃいられない、早く連中を止め――: …The Demon King's army is nearby!? We can't just stand here—we have to stop them right away—
m920123.……魔界の未踏地域に、魔王軍が？\nそうか魔王め、とうとう探し求めていた\n『力: …The Demon King's army in the uncharted region of the Demon Realm? So the Demon King finally moved to retrieve the “power” he's been seeking.
m920123.『破滅の力』……？\nもしや、魔王が集めている『力』の事か……！: “Power of Ruin”…? Could it be the “power” the Demon King has been gathering…!
m920123.『迷宮アヴァリティア』では、こういった話は\n避けたほうが良さそうですね。\nそ: In “Labyrinth Avalitia,” it's probably best to avoid this kind of talk. Then, let's proceed cautiously toward the depths of the maze.
m920123.あぁっ、モーティマなんかに負けないんだから！\n王子が持ちきれないくらい、\n財: Ah, I won't lose to Mortimer! I have to get enough treasure that even you can't carry!
m920123.ああ、やはり強者との戦いだろうさ。\n血湧き肉躍る、魂を削り合うような\n極上の: Ah, it'll have to be a fight against the strong. If there's an opponent that makes our blood boil, our souls clash, a truly superb battle—
m920123.ああ、想像したとおりのものが出てくるとなれば、\nこれは期待してしまうじゃないか: Ah, if it turns out exactly as we imagined, I can't help but look forward to it.
m920123.ああ。確かにこの『迷宮』の\n奥から『力』の存在を感じる。: Yes. I can definitely feel the presence of power emanating from its depths.
m920123.あっ……い、行ってしまいました……。\n『力』が欲しければ迷宮の奥まで来い、\n: Ah… they've already left… They said if we want “power” we have to go to the heart of the labyrinth…
m920123.あなたの欲望、叶えてあげましょう♪\nさぁ、思う存分戦ってくださいね？: I'll grant your desires, ♪ now go ahead and fight to your heart's content, okay?
m920123.あの、マンモンさん……？\n今日はどんなご用事なのでしょうか？: Um, Mammon…? What brings you here today?
m920123.あら……？ また私の負けでしょうか？\nふふっ、ふふふっ、なんて愉快なのでしょう: Oh…? Another defeat, perhaps? Heh, hehehe, how delightful!
m920123.あら、あらあら……？\nどうしましょう、もしかして……。: Oh dear, oh dear…? What shall we do, could it be…
m920123.あら、あらあら、あなた達もあの『力』が欲しいの？\nんん、別にどうしても手元に置:
Oh? You want that “power” too?
Hmm, I don't really need to keep it for myself, I could give it to you…
m920123.あら、あらあら。もう気付いてしまったのですか？\nけれど幻とはいえ、この力の中で: Oh my, have you finally noticed? Even if it's an illusion, the pain within this power is real. How long can you endure our attacks?
m920123.あら、あらあらあら、私を知っているのね？\nでもそうねぇ、何事にも対価が必要なも:
Oh my, you know me?
But you see, everything has a price.
How about you entertain me for a bit?
m920123.あら、あらあら？\nもう追いついてきてしまったのですか？:
Oh my, oh my my?
Have you finally caught up with us?
m920123.あら、あらあら？\nもしかして私抜きで遊び始めちゃってませんか？\nもうっ、欲張: Oh my, oh my? Are you playing without me? You greedy lot…!!
m920123.あらあら、思ったより楽しいじゃない。\nふふふ、ちょっとだけ\n本気を出しそうに:
Well, well, this is more fun than I thought.
Heh, you almost got serious for a moment, didn't you?
m920123.あれ……？ おかしいなぁ……。\nどこにも財宝なんて見当たらないんだけど……。: Huh…? That's odd… I don't see any treasure anywhere…
m920123.い、いや待て、\nこれ以上の強敵が出たらどうするつもりだ。: N-no, wait—what are we supposed to do if even stronger enemies appear?
m920123.いいえ、魔物が接近しているならちょうどいいわ。\n王子達の実力を見極めるのなら、: No, if the monsters are approaching, that's perfect. If we're testing the Prince's abilities, a chaotic battle is actually more useful.
m920123.いいや、問題ない。\nガリウスが動くことを予期して、\n魔力の回復に努めていたか: No, it's fine. I've been preparing magical recovery anticipating Garius's move.
m920123.いえ、帝国と王国は協力関係にありますから、\n緊急事態にはお互い様です。\nそう: No, the Empire and the Kingdom are allies, so we help each other in emergencies. That's right, Prince?
m920123.いたたた……あの獣人ちゃん、\n思いっきりぶつんだから……いたたた……。: Ouch… that beast-person just slammed into me… Ouch…
m920123.う、うるせぇ！ ――って、な、なんだぁ！？\nさっきまで迷宮にいたのに、\nいつ: Hey, shut up! —Wha—what the—! We were in the labyrinth a moment ago, and now we're in a place I've never seen!
m920123.うぅぅ……ぐすっ……ふぇっ？\nあっ、魔界にはもっと強い生き物が\nいーっぱいい: Uuu… sniff… huh? Ah, there are way more powerful creatures in the demon world…?
m920123.お、おい、まわりが山の中に変わったと思ったら、\n今度は宝箱が見えるぞ？\n俺の: Hey, hey, the surroundings turned into mountains, and now I see a treasure chest? Is my eyes playing tricks on me?!
m920123.おいおい、お前は高みの見物か？: Hey, hey, are you just watching from the sidelines?
m920123.おう、確かに悪意っていうよりも、\n遊んでもらえて楽しいって感じだったなぁ。: Yeah, it felt less like malice and more like fun—having her play along.
m920123.お頭、俺にも見えるぜ！\n間違いない、こいつは宝の山だ！！\n金銀財宝がざっくざ: Boss, I can see it too! No doubt, this is a mountain of treasure!! Gold and silver piled up everywhere!!
m920123.かつてのように何処へでもというわけにはいかないが、\n私が以前調査した『力』の在: We can't go anywhere like before, but to the location I previously investigated—opening a gate… wouldn't be impossible.
m920123.くっ……さすがは魔神ということか。\n我輩が押されているとは……！！: Damn… as expected of a demon god. To think I'm being pushed back…!!
m920123.くっ！ 魔神と同時に相手にするには分が悪い。\nまだ立ち上がってくるとはな……っ: Damn! It's hard to fight the demon god and him at once. He even gets back up…!
m920123.こちら側に迫ってきたヴァンパイアも、\n無事に掃討が完了しております。: The vampires that advanced toward us have also been successfully eliminated.
