m920123.我が『王者の構え』をとる限り、\n遠距離攻撃など全て無意味と思い知れィッ！！: As long as I hold my “King's Stance,” all ranged attacks are meaningless—learn that!
m920123.我こそは魔王軍幹部にして\n百獣のチャンピオン、ガオレオンであるッ！\nいざ声援: I am Gaoleon, the Demon King's elite and Champion of the Hundred Beasts! With your cheers behind me, let the ring begin!
m920123.断言は出来ないが、\nわざわざ軍を魔界の未踏地域へ向かわせたなら、\n『力』の所: I can't say for certain, but if he sent an army all the way to the uncharted region, we can assume they've pinpointed its location.
m920123.本当の実力を見ておく必要があったのよ。\n何しろ行き先は、魔界の未踏地域だからね: We needed to see the real power. After all, our destination is an uncharted region of the Demon Realm.
m920123.来たことのある場所だったからな。\nいつでもどこへでも自由に\nゲートを開けると:
I've been here before.
Just because we can open gates anywhere doesn't mean we can do it whenever we want.
m920123.獣人の、幹部だと……？\nそうかガリウスめ、\n新たな幹部を魔王軍に迎えたという: A beast-man's executive, huh? I see, Galius—so you've taken a new commander into the Demon Army.
m920123.王国の今の実力を、わたし達に見せてほしいの。\nこれは王子達にとっても必要なこと: I want you to show us the kingdom's current strength. It's something the Prince and his companions need, too.
m920123.王子、お前何やってんだ！？\nガオレオンの爪を受け止めるなんてよぉ！？: Prince, what are you doing!? Trying to block Gaoleon's claw!?
m920123.王子、ここから先は何が起きるか分かりません。\n十分な準備をしてから進軍しましょ: Prince, we have no idea what lies ahead. Let's make sure we're fully prepared before we advance.
m920123.王子、すまないな。客人であるお前達にまで、\n事態の鎮圧を手伝わせてしまうとは…: Prince, I'm sorry. I never imagined we'd have to ask our guests to help suppress this situation...
m920123.王子、デシウスの言うとおり、\nこの先には過酷な戦いが待ち受けているはずです。\: Prince, just as Decius said, harsh battles lie ahead. Steel yourself and press on.
m920123.王子、デシウスの言葉を信じるのなら、\n『破滅の力』とは千年戦争当時の魔王の力だ: Prince, if you trust Decius's words, the “Power of Ruin” is the demon king's power from the Millennium War.
m920123.王子、マンモンさんまで向かってきます！\n気を抜かず迎撃してくださいっ！！: Prince, Mammon's coming at us! Stay sharp and intercept!
m920123.王子、過去の私達に勝ちましょう。\n思い出に負けていては、\nここから先には進め:
Prince, let's defeat our past selves.
If we lose to our memories, we can't move forward from here.
m920123.王子に興味がわいたとは……。\nえぇと、仲間に加わっていただける、\nということ: You're interested in the Prince…? So… you mean you'd join our side?
m920123.王者の爪にかかることを光栄に思えッ！！\n散れィ、魔神マンモン――ッ！！: Be honored to be struck by the king's claw!! Disperse, demon Mammon—!!
m920123.真の力を取り戻した魔王ですら、\n私達の手には余る存在だったというのに……。\n: Even the Demon King who regained his true power was beyond our grasp… And if he obtains the “Power of Ruin”…
m920123.私の力で満たしたこの迷宮は、欲望を映す鏡です。\nこの迷宮の中であれば、誰もが願:
This labyrinth I've filled with my power is a mirror that reflects desire.
Within it, anyone can have their wishes granted.
Come now, I'll satisfy your greed!
m920123.私の身に宿っている力も、もとを辿れば魔王のものだ。\n人が魔王の力を振るうことも: The power residing within me also traces back to the demon king. It might not be impossible for a mortal to wield it.
m920123.私はこの『迷宮アヴァリティア』を統べる者。\n名前は、そうね、マンモンと呼ぶとい:
I am the ruler of this Labyrinth Avalitia.
You may call me Mammon.
You're the second group of guests today?
m920123.私達人間にはありがたい話ですね……。\nシャディアさん、\nこの『迷宮』の奥に『:
That's a blessing for us humans…
Shadia, there's “power” deep inside this labyrinth, right?
m920123.聞こえなかったのか？\nそれなら、もう一度説明してやるか……。: Didn't hear it? Then I'll explain again…
m920123.覚醒した今の力に加え、過去の己の力を得ることで、\n更なる能力を得ることを画策し: By adding that awakened power to his own past strength, he's plotting to gain even greater abilities.
m920123.負傷者を出してしまったことは謝罪しよう。\nしかし今回に限っては、生半可な戦力で: I'll apologize for the casualties. But this time, half-hearted forces would have been like sending us straight into a death trap.
m920123.財宝のことはともかく、\n魔界に棲息する魔物の強さは底が知れませんね……。\nそ: Treasure aside, the strength of demons living in the demon world is limitless… This glimpse is what we gained this time.
m920123.財宝を求めて寄ってくる者を食う為の、\n罠だった……ということでしょうか……。: It was a trap to eat those who come seeking treasure… is that what it means…
m920123.過去の魔王の力、その欠片だったなんて。\nそんな力を手に入れたとして、\n私達が: A fragment of the ancient demon king's power… Even if we got it, could we actually use it…?
m920123.集めれば魔王打倒の切り札になるかもしれない、\nという『力』でしたね……。\nい: If we gather it, it could be the trump card to defeat the Demon King… that “power”… what exactly is it?
m920123.雪原での戦いのことか……。あれはあくまで、\n魔王様の器に収まるだけの力に過ぎな: You're thinking of the battle in the snowfield… that was merely power that fit within the Demon King's vessel.
m920123.雷を放出し終えると自然に消滅するとも聞きます。\n遠矢や魔法で力を削ると良いかも: I've heard it vanishes once it's done releasing lightning. Weakening it with long-range attacks or magic might work. Prince, please command carefully.
m920123.願望の投影ではなく、現実の世界でこそ、\nあんな平和な世界を\n実現していかなけ: It's not a projected wish but in the real world that we must create that peaceful world.
m920123.魔王軍が先行しているのなら、\nここで躊躇う暇はないだろう。\n王子、お前もそれ: If the Demon King's army is already ahead, we don't have time to linger. Prince, are you okay with that?
m920123.魔王軍への対応だけでも厄介だというのに、\nまったく、手間をかけさせてくれるな…: Dealing with the Demon King's army is already a hassle, and now this... they really know how to make things difficult.
m920123.魔界の……？\nどうやら想定以上に深刻な案件のようですね。: The Demon Realm…? It looks more serious than we expected.
m920123.魔界の未踏地域にあるという『迷宮』、\nどうやらここで間違いなさそうだ。\nまさ:
The “labyrinth” said to be in the uncharted region of the Demon Realm… looks like this is it.
I never imagined they'd open a direct gate…
m920123.魔界の未踏地域に向かう、ということでしたが、\nそこでいったい何が起きているので: We were supposed to head to the uncharted region of the Demon Realm, but… what's actually happening there?
m920123.（そうですね、素直というか、一途というか……。\nちゃんとお話すれば『力』のとこ:
(Indeed, he's honest—or perhaps single-minded…
If we talk properly, maybe he'll guide us all the way to the “Power”?)
m920123.（欲望に流されず、誰かを助けるために戦う？\nこんな人間がいるなんて……ど、どう: (Fighting without being swayed by desire, to help someone? Humans like this exist… What should I do? I'm kinda interested… no, very interested…!)

m920210.――あなたを、仮死にしてあげる。: —I shall put you into a state of suspended animation.
m920210.――ってやつ、言ってみたかったんだ。: ――That's the line I wanted to say.
m920210.――なんだとッ！？\nもう一度言ってみろ！:
What did you say?!
Say that again!
m920210.――はッ！？ ここはいったい……？\nそうだ、私の妻と娘と母とママが昏睡状態で！:
Hah?! Where am I…?
That's right! My wife, my daughter, and my mother are in a coma!
m920210.――ふぅ。どうやら片付いたみたいね。\nどう？ 女の子は目覚めた？:
Phew. Looks like we're done here.
Did the girl wake up?
m920210.――ほう、いいだろう。\n貴様らは顎を砕かれても「まずい」と言えるのか？:
――Hmph, very well.
Can you still say it's "terrible" with your jaw broken?
m920210.――ワルツに手を出すな、災厄の魔女スィーテン。: —Don't lay a hand on Waltz, you witch of calamity, Suiten.
m920210.――伝令ですッ！\n王都周辺にて、大勢の女性が次々と倒れたようです！\n全員が昏:
A messenger!
A large number of women have collapsed one after another around the capital!
They are all in a coma, and the damage appears to be severe!
m920210.――助けてください！\n魔物に襲われています！:
Please… help me!
I'm being attacked by monsters!
m920210.……あなたの、目的は何？\nどうして、人々を眠らせるの？:
……What is your purpose?
Why are you putting people to sleep?
m920210.……パンプキンデウスたち、消えてしまいましたね。\nちゃんと、魔力の籠っていない:
……Pumpkin Deus and the others have vanished.
They left behind pumpkins that contain no mana.
m920210.『大切な人たちに危害を加えやがって』。\nあなたを討つには、そんな小規模な怒りで:
“You dared to harm the people we cherish.”
That small spark of anger is enough to defeat you.
m920210.あ、ああ……味のせいで目覚めた訳ではないんだな。\nだったらいいんだ、だったら…:
Ah, I see… it wasn't the taste that woke them up.
Well, that's fine, that's…
m920210.ああ、あいつは過去、十二回の敗北を喫している。\nその十二回とも、敵対した相手に:
Ah, yes. She suffered twelve defeats in the past.
And in all twelve, she left devastating destruction behind.
You'd do well to give up on the victims, for your own peace of mind.
m920210.ああ、あの女性を助けよう。\nただ、気を付けるべきは――。:
Yes, let's help that woman.
However, we must be careful about—
m920210.ああ、つい数日前に、偶然見かけてな。\nモーロンは貴様らに一度敗北したあと、\n: Yes. I happened to spot her a few days ago. After losing to you all, she apparently moved her base to a different forest.
m920210.ああ、やはり人間の心はうつくしい。\n私の葉と茎を焦がすその怒りさえ。:
Ah, human hearts truly are beautiful.
Even that anger which scorches my leaves and stems.
m920210.ああ、乾びる乾びる、その前に。\n私が、すべてのうつくしい心を押し花に変える！:
Ah, withering, withering, before that happens.
I will turn every beautiful heart into a pressed flower!
m920210.ああ、何度でも言ってやる！\nシャディア、お前の作るチョコは……まずい！:
Sure, I'll say it as many times as you like!
Shadia, your chocolate is… terrible!
m920210.ああ、分かった。\n急ごう皆、振り返らず走るぞ。:
Ah, I see.
Let's hurry. Run without looking back.
m920210.ああ、分かった。\n目指すはお菓子の街・移転地！\nいざ、眠れる女性たちを救う決: Understood. Our destination is the Candy Town relocation site! Let's go, to the decisive battle to save the sleeping women!
m920210.ああ、色が濃く実が詰まって、いいカボチャだ！\n植物に対する深い理解がなければ、:
Ah, look at that deep color and how plump they are!
Only someone with a profound understanding of plants could cultivate them like this.
m920210.ああ。チョコ騎士団長殿の命により、\n目下見廻り中なのだ。ただ、モテボーイ軍以上: I do. I'm on patrol by order of the Chocolate Knight Commander. But I don't think we have any more information than the Hot Boy Army.
m920210.あなたにとって、うつくしいものとはなんですか？\nうつくしいあなたの思う、うつく:
What is beautiful to you?
The beautiful thing that beautiful you believes in.
m920210.あら、腰が抜けてしまったのかしら？: Oh my, has your strength completely left you?
m920210.あれは――パンプキンデウス！？\n馬鹿な、奴は……ええと……。\nしばらく見てい:
That's—Pumpkin Deus!
Impossible, he's… um…
I haven't seen him in a while, so I thought he was dead…
m920210.あれは……チョコ騎士団と、シャディアさん？\nなんだか言い争ってるけど。:
Is that… the Chocolate Knights and Shadia?
They seem to be in a bit of a dispute.
m920210.うう～、身体はほかほか、空気はひえひえ。\n寒暖差で倒れそう……って、ほんとに誰:
Ugh~ My body is hot, but the air is freezing.
I might collapse from the temperature difference… Wait, is someone actually collapsing?
m920210.うつくしいですね。\n貴方と、仲間たち。その信頼と勇気は。:
You are so beautiful.
You and your companions. That trust and courage of yours.
m920210.うつくしい心が、枯れ果てる前に。\n奇麗なままで、揃えて並べて飾っていたいの。:
Before those beautiful hearts wither away.
I want to gather them, line them up, and display them
while they are still pristine.
m920210.うつくしくあろうとしないのは、うつくしくない。\n既に枯れた者は、私がこの手で…:
To refuse beauty is not beautiful.
Those who have already withered… I shall handle them with my own hands…
m920210.うつくしくなくなる、可能性。\nそれを打ち消すために、私は戦う！:
The possibility of them losing their beauty.
I fight to erase that possibility!
m920210.うぬの考え方は、我にはまるで分らぬが。\nそんなにカボチャが好きなら、置いていく:
I cannot fathom your way of thinking, Kabo…
If you love pumpkins so much, I'll leave these behind, Kabo…
m920210.うん、全部片付いたみたい。\nお姉さん、怪我はありませんか？:
Yes, it looks like we've dealt with everything.
Miss, are you hurt?
m920210.うん、悪い奴感出してくれると攻撃しやすくて助かるね。\nでも、この足音は……。:
Yeah, it'd help if you gave off a bit of a "bad guy" vibe so it's easier to attack you.
But, these footsteps are…
m920210.うん、昏睡していた人たちの意識は、戻らないまま。\nスィーテンも取り逃がして、な:
Yeah. The people who were in a coma still haven't regained consciousness.
And we let Suiten slip away… It really feels like we lost.
m920210.うん。だからそんな大規模なことを言っても、\n同じようなことを返してくれると思わ:
Yes. So don't expect us to respond
to such grandiose threats with the same kind of rhetoric.
m920210.ええ、人びとはすべて、かしに。\n街はあちらの、明るい色の道を駆けた先です。:
Yes, everyone is up in the sky.
The town is down that brightly lit path, just a short run away.
m920210.ええ、行きましょう。この悪夢を終わらせるために。: Yes, let's go. To end this nightmare.
m920210.ええ。誇らしい人たちです。\n……ところで、もう歩けるのですか？\nそれに、そっ:
Yes, they are truly admirable people.
…By the way, can you walk now?
Besides, that isn't the path everyone else took—
m920210.えっ……なんだそのコスい悪事……知らん……。: Huh... What a nasty thing to do... I didn't know.
m920210.えっ……？ ああごめんなさい、大切なことよね。\n皆、毒沼には気をつけて戦いまし:
Oh…? I'm sorry, that's very important.
Everyone, please be careful of the poison swamp!
m920210.おい王子、なにもこんな奴の話を！\n……いや、背に腹は代えられん。:
Hey, Prince, why are we listening to this woman!
...No, I suppose we have no choice.
m920210.お菓子に睡眠薬をたっぷり混ぜりゃ、\n眠らせられはするだろうが……あたしに何の得:
I suppose mixing a ton of sleeping pills into sweets
would put people to sleep, but... what's in it for me?
m920210.お菓子の街の住民みたいな見た目なのにね。\n……みて、あそこにモーロンがいる。: Even though they look just like the residents of Candy Town. ……Look, there's Mooron.
m920210.かくかくしかじかシュシュふわふわ。: So it went like this, and then this, and then that...
m920210.かし……菓子？\nそうだとしたら、お菓子の魔女たる\nモーロンのしわざに違いあり:
A treat… a pastry?
If that's the case, it must be the work of Moron,
the Witch of Sweets!
m920210.き、気付いていたっていうのかい！？\n近隣のちびっこ達に『交換こ』と称してガワだ:
Y-You knew about that?!
That I tricked the local kids into a "trade" with fake shells,
while I pocketed the real sweets for myself!
m920210.きっと、この辺りの毒沼のせいね。\n魔法のクッキーも、なんだか調子が悪そうにして:
It's probably the poison swamp around here.
Even my magic cookies seem a bit under the weather.
m920210.くうっ……ここは、撤退するカボ……。\n今年のバレンタインは、チョコに譲るカボ…:
Grrh… We shall withdraw from here, Kabo…
This year's Valentine's Day, we yield to chocolate, Kabo…
m920210.くっ……なんだあいつ、一人で盛り上がって！: Ugh… What's with her, getting all worked up on her own?
m920210.こいつらは、チョコからカカオを吸収し再生する！\nかつてない新時代の魔物さぁ！:
These guys absorb the cocoa from the chocolate and regenerate!
They're monsters of a brand-new era!
m920210.こういうのはどうせモーロンの仕業とは思うが、\n彼女の縄張りには、我々だけでは近: I figure this is Mooron's doing, but we can't get close to her territory on our own……
m920210.ここが、私たちの街です。\n皆が眠りについた、静かでうつくしい街。:
This is our town.
A quiet, beautiful town where everyone has fallen asleep.
m920210.こっちは冤罪かけられてんだ、このくらい当然さ。\nあたしとしても、あいつが伐たれ:
I've been framed, so this is the least I can do.
Besides, I'd be over the moon if she were put down.
m920210.こと薬学の深度に関しては、華の国に一日の長がある。\n私用のついでと称し、華王み:
When it comes to the depth of pharmacology, the Flower Country holds the edge.
The King of Flowers himself came to lend us some old medical texts, claiming it was a personal errand.
Given the recent incident, I suppose that's a fair assumption.
m920210.この毒の沼地は、人間には危険です。\n体力が削がれては勿体ないです。\n回復しな:
This poisonous swamp is dangerous for humans.
It would be a waste to have your stamina drained.
Please fight while healing yourselves. I beg you.
m920210.この濁ってるなりに曇りなき瞳……。\nまさか、本当に知らないのかしら。\nキャロ:
Those eyes are murky, but they're clear enough...
Could it be that she really doesn't know?
Calope, explain the situation to her.
m920210.これも、シャディアさんのチョコのお陰です。\nあの奇跡的な調合の発見が、特効薬の:
That's thanks to Shadia's chocolate.
The discovery of that miraculous recipe
greatly advanced the creation of a specific antidote.
m920210.さあ、眠らせた人たちの目を覚ます方法を教えなさい。: Now tell us how to wake the people you put to sleep.
m920210.さあ、行きましょう。眠れる乙女の目を覚まし、\nよきバレンタインを迎えるために！:
Now, let's go. We'll wake the sleeping maidens
and ensure a happy Valentine's Day!
m920210.せっかくだから、あれ言っちゃうね。\n『王子、ご指示をお願いします！』:
Since we're here, I might as well say it.
“Prince, please give us your orders!”
m920210.ぜェ、ぜェ……んぁア？\n眠らせるってなんだい。あたしゃ知らないよ。:
Phew... Phew... Huh?
Put to sleep? I have no idea what you're talking about.
m920210.そう……って、モーロンの居場所を知っているの！？: Wait…… you know where Mooron is?
m920210.そういう魔力は、魔物たちを引き付けるから厄介だよね。\nほら、辺りを気配が囲って:
That kind of magic tends to attract monsters, so it's a nuisance.
Look, the area is being surrounded by hostile presences.
m920210.そうはいくかい、こちらも新作を用意してんのさ！\n食べても食べても無くならないガ:
Not so fast, I've got a new trick up my sleeve!
Ever seen a chocolate cake that never runs out,
no matter how much you eat?
m920210.そこまでよ、お菓子の魔女！\n貴方の働いた悪事は、すべて把握しています！:
That's enough, you candy witch!
I know every last thing you've been up to.
m920210.それから、こうやって私を助けにきちゃう王子様とか。: And the Prince who comes rushing to my rescue like this.
m920210.それで昏睡させるだなんて、身勝手なひと。\nお生憎様、私たちは自分の意思で踊って:
To put them into a coma is so selfish.
I'm sorry, but we prefer to dance by our own will.
m920210.それに、美しくないとされた何かが、\nうっかり誰かを救ってしまうこともある。\n:
Besides, something deemed "not beautiful" might accidentally save someone's life.
Walking alongside all those possibilities is what the Kingdom's army is all about, right?
m920210.そんなに気を落とさないで。\n王国には、たくさんの協力者がいる。\nきっと誰かが:
Don't be so down.
The Kingdom has plenty of allies.
Someone out there will surely find a way to solve this.
m920210.たッ……大変だ！\nシャディアのまずいチョコを食べさせたら、\n昏睡していた女性:
It's… it's a miracle!
I made the woman in the coma eat Shadia's terrible chocolate, and she briefly regained consciousness!
m920210.だ、ダルク……！？\n貴方たしか、今日は街に行くって……。\nそれに、その腕の怪:
D-D'Arc…!?
You said you were going into the town today…
And that injury on your arm…
m920210.だが、いかにもな歯は厄介だな。\n即昏睡とはいかないだろうが、\n何度も噛まれれ:
But those obvious teeth are a nuisance.
It won't be instant unconsciousness, but
if they get bitten enough times, they won't be able to move properly.
m920210.だが今回は、望み持つ者に呼ばれた訳じゃないカボ。\nされば、我らは自由に動けるカ:
But this time, we were not summoned by one who wished for it, Kabo.
Therefore, we are free to act as we please, Kabo…
Our true purpose is to eradicate all cacao…
m920210.つまり、コソコソやるのが上手いってことかしら？: So the culprit is good at being sneaky, I suppose?
m920210.でも、シャディアさんが悪いようにも……？\n――って、わわっ！？ なにやら緊迫し:
But it does seem like Shadia's in the wrong…
――Oh my! There's a tense atmosphere building!
m920210.でも、悪いことしてたのは確定みたい。\nそもそも前科者だし、このままやっつけちゃ:
Still, it looks like she's definitely guilty.
Plus, she's a repeat offender. Let's just take her down.
m920210.でも人間が、諦めない心の大切さを教えてくれた！\nだから私は折れない……ギッ――:
But humans have taught me the value of a heart that never gives up!
So I shall not break… Gik――Juuuoo!!
m920210.というか、向かってきてますよ～！？: And they're coming right at us!
m920210.というか、眠ってるみたいです！？\nお～い、風邪ひいちゃいますよ～？:
Actually, it looks like they're sleeping!
Hey, you'll catch a cold!
m920210.ともあれ、災厄の魔女たちに関しては\nまだまだ警戒が必要ですね。:
In any case, we still need to remain vigilant
regarding the witches of calamity.
m920210.どうやら、事件のようですね。\nまずは被害状況の把握が先決です。\n急ぎ、城へと:
It seems we have a situation on our hands.
Our first priority is to assess the extent of the damage.
We need to return to the castle immediately!
m920210.どうやら、戦闘は避けられなさそうね。\n皆、気を引き締めていきましょう！:
It seems we can't avoid a fight.
Everyone, brace yourselves!
m920210.なあ、ワルツ。綿密な作戦を敷いたうえでの潜入と、\n愚直で粗雑な正面突破、どちら: Waltz. Do you prefer a meticulous infiltration plan, or a straightforward, rough frontal assault?
m920210.なに、近くまで案内してくれたら充分だ。\n申し出は嬉しいが、命まで懸けさせる訳に: No, just guiding us close enough is plenty. I appreciate the offer, but I can't ask you to risk your life.
m920210.なんか変なにおいがする……。\nああえっと、シャディアさんのチョコの事じゃなくて:
I can smell something strange…
Oh, and I don't mean Shadia's chocolate, okay?
m920210.ねえ、チョコ騎士さん。\n街で起きている昏睡事件について、なにか知ってる？: Hey, Chocolate Knight. Do you know anything about the coma cases happening in the city?
m920210.ねえ私、やっぱりスィーテンとは相容れないの。\n美しくても、そうじゃなくても、生:
Hey, I really can't get along with Suiten, can I?
Whether you're beautiful or not, you have the right to keep living.
m920210.はい、怪我はありません。\nただ私の街は今、魔女の手の内にあるんです。:
No, I'm not injured.
But my town is currently in the witch's clutches.
m920210.はい。私は、昏睡事件の渦中にいました。\n周囲の女性が次々倒れる中、応戦すること:
Yes. I was right in the middle of the coma incident.
As the women around me collapsed one after another, I couldn't even fight back…
m920210.はーい、シャディアさんどうどうっ。\nチョコ騎士団の皆さんに、『ごめんね』しまし: All right, Shadia, sweetie. Let's apologize to the Chocolate Knights.
m920210.ふぅ、バレンタインに食べるお菓子も集まってきたねぇ。\n王国軍の目を掻い潜り、細: Phew, I've managed to gather up the sweets for Valentine's Day. It's the result of my careful work, avoiding the Royal Army's eyes.
m920210.ふふ、とってもお上手ですよ。\nところで、異変というのは……？:
Hehe, you're very good at that.
By the way, what is this “strange occurrence”?
m920210.ぺちぺちぺちぺちぺちぺちぺち。: Pat, pat, pat, pat, pat, pat, pat.
m920210.ほら、この人型クッキーに奴の魔力の残滓を込めた。\nこいつを手のひらに乗せれば、:
See, I've imbued this humanoid cookie with the remnants of her power.
If you hold it in your palm, you should find yourself walking straight to her.
m920210.ほら皆、もう少しよ！\n寒中稽古のラストスパート、頑張りましょう！:
Come on, everyone, hang in there!
It's the final push of our winter training. Let's give it our all!
m920210.ほんとうの街は、こちらに。この暗き道の先に。\nうつくしさの損なわれない、完璧な:
??? : The real town is this way. Beyond this dark path.
Please, come to the perfect garden, where beauty remains unblemished.
m920210.ま、待ってください！\nその子からなんだか、いや～な魔力が……。:
W-Wait a moment!
There's an unpleasant magical aura coming from that girl…
m920210.まあ、本当にトコトコし始めた。\nありがとう魔女さん、次に会う時は敵でしょうけど:
Well, I really am starting to toddle along.
Thank you, witch. I suppose we'll be enemies when we meet again.
m920210.まさか、カカオが鍵だったとはな。\nグルメジャングルの騒動も、\nカカオを恐れた:
To think cacao was the key.
The commotion in the Gourmet Jungle
must have been Suiten's doing, too, out of fear of cacao.
m920210.まずは、あいつを止めるしかないな。\n被害者を増やさなければ我々の勝利。\n目を:
First, we have no choice but to stop her.
If we prevent further casualties, we win.
If we can find a way to wake them up, it's a decisive victory.
m920210.まるで植物そのものと話している気分だったよ。\nスィーテン――貴様いったい、何者:
It felt like I was talking to a plant.
Suiten—what exactly are you?
m920210.まッ――待ってくれ！\nおいしそうなカボチャごと消えないでくれ！:
Ma—wait!
Don't disappear along with those tasty-looking pumpkins!
m920210.みなさん、おはようございます！\nわるい奴の討伐を行うため、速やかに避難してくだ:
Good morning, everyone!
We're going to take down the bad guy, so please evacuate immediately!
The Knights of the Chocolate Body will guide you!
m920210.むっ……助けを求める声がする。\n魔女探しはちょっとだけお休みだね。:
Hmph… I hear someone calling for help.
We'll put the witch hunt on a short break.
m920210.もうすぐバレンタインの祝祭ですが、\nあまり浮かれずに気を引き締めていきましょう:
The Valentine's Festival is just around the corner,
but let's keep our heads and stay on guard.
m920210.もっと美しい姿、見せてさしあげます。\n皆、まずは街の人々を助けましょう！:
I will show you a far more beautiful sight.
Everyone, let's save the townspeople first!
m920210.やる気か？ 我らはチョコさえあれば負傷知らず。\n知り合いの町娘……の、お母さん: Oh, you're up for a fight? We're invincible as long as we have chocolate. Let's stock up on that cocoa power and heal up, wounds and jaws alike!
m920210.わだ、しは、あきらめない。\n必ずまた立ち上がり、ひとびとを、うつくしいまま……:
I… will… not… give… up.
I will surely rise again, and keep the people… beautiful…
m920210.ギャッ――あなた達が、どうしてこの街に。\n明るい道の先は茨の迷路、二度と戻って:
Gyaah—why are you in this town?
The path of light leads to a labyrinth of thorns. There is no way you could have returned.
m920210.クヒュヒュ、ボクもいるカボよ！\n蒔かれて実って大復活、夢の共演カボ～☆:
Kikikiki, I'm here too, Kabo!
Sown, grown, and greatly revived, a dreamy duet, Kabo~☆
m920210.シャルロットさん監修の精神支配大全で調べよう。\nええと、寄生する花の魔物は……:
Let's check it out in Charlotte's *Complete Guide to Mind Control*.
Um, parasitic flower monsters… there it is.
Yeah, judging by the host's complexion, they should wake up once we take the monster down.
m920210.スィーテン……お前やマズゥに並ぶ、災厄の魔女。\nある小国の軍隊に敗北し、死亡し:
Sweeten... A witch of calamity on par with you or Mazu.
I heard she was defeated by the army of a small nation and killed.
m920210.スィーテンが……地面に潜って逃げていきます～！？: Suiten is… burrowing into the ground and trying to escape~!?
m920210.スィーテンの居場所を示してくれてるんだっけ？\n結構歩いたから、そろそろ着いても:
I thought they were showing us where Sweeten is?
We've been walking for quite a while, so we should be close…
m920210.チョコかカボチャか、どちらかだけなんて寂しいだろう。\n皆で分け合い、皆でお腹い:
It would be a shame to have only chocolate or only pumpkins.
Let's share them all and eat until we're full.
That is the happiest thing of all.
m920210.チョコ騎士団の皆、すごく遠くで見守ってくれてる。\n巻き込まれちゃ大変だものね。: The Chocolate Knights are watching from a safe distance. It would be a disaster if they got caught up in this.
m920210.チョコ騎士団は、お母さんのチョコで体力を回復する。\nあの箱には近付けないほうが: The Chocolate Knights recover their stamina with their mother's chocolate. It's probably best to keep your distance from that box.
m920210.バレンタインに、チョコを贈るなーー！: On Valentine's Day, do NOT give out chocolate!
m920210.バレンタインの祝祭が迫るチョコ沼地帯に、\nなにやら異変が起きつつあるという。:
There are signs of something strange happening in the Chocolate Marshlands,
just as the Valentine's Festival approaches.
m920210.バレンタインをカボチャで埋め尽くす。\nまずはうぬら全員、カボチャパンツにしてや:
We shall bury Valentine's Day in pumpkins.
First, I'll turn you all into pumpkin pants, Kabo…!
m920210.パンプキンデウスに神性はない。\n神を騙る木偶など、畑の肥やしにしてやろう。:
Pumpkin Deus has no divinity.
Let's reduce this false god puppet to fertilizer for the fields.
m920210.ワルツ、気にしないで。身体に張りかけた根を、\n取り除いただけだから。:
Waltz, don't worry about it.
I just removed the roots that were trying to take hold of my body.
m920210.一触即発ね。仲裁に入ってあげましょう。: It's on the verge of a brawl. Let's step in and mediate.
m920210.二度と会いたかないよ、とっとと行きな！\n元気なうちにお菓子をたらふく食っとくん:
I don't want to see you again, so get going!
Eat your fill of sweets while you still can!
m920210.人間を愛する、善き魔女です。\nさあ、おいでなさい。私の花たち。:
I am a good witch who loves humans.
Now, come here. My flowers.
m920210.今は緊急事態ですもの。\n――より、情熱的なほうを。: It's an emergency. ……I'd go with the passionate option.
m920210.他にも、叡智の園や世界樹の皆さん、\n華の国にも協力をいただき、無事に解決と相成:
We also received cooperation from the Garden of Wisdom, the World Tree,
and the Flower Country, and the matter was resolved safely.
m920210.住民の避難は終わったみたい。\nこれで、元気いっぱい戦えるね。:
The evacuation seems to be finished.
Now we can fight with all our might!
m920210.何度でも蘇る不屈の災厄。\n雑草のようなクソ女さ。\nあたしを見逃すんなら、居場:
An unyielding calamity that rises time and again.
A weed-like bitch.
If you let me go, I'll give you a clue to her whereabouts.
m920210.全然起きる気配がありません！\nキャロップちゃんの兎耳ビンタを受けているのに！:
No sign of her waking up at all!
Even after Calope gave her a smack with her bunny ears!
m920210.出会った時より、貴様を怪しんでいたから対処ができた。\n殺気や悪意を消すのが得意:
I was suspicious of you from the moment we met, so I was prepared.
It seems you're good at erasing killing intent and malice… but you've erased too much.
m920210.刻んだチョコを……目の細かいザルで濾して……、\n沸騰直前まで煮立てた生クリーム:
Melt the chopped chocolate… strain it through a fine sieve…
then add the cream just before it boils…
m920210.力をあわせ歩みゆく姿、これもうつくしい。\nああ早く仮死に、仮死にしなければ。:
The sight of you walking together, united in strength… it is beautiful.
Ah, I must put them into a state of suspended animation, quickly.
m920210.問題は、次の被害をどう防ぐかですね。\nなにか、犯人の手掛かりを掴めればいいので:
The problem is how to prevent the next victim.
If only we could get a lead on the culprit…
m920210.地中まで深追いはできないだろう。\nどのみち、あの傷ではまともに動けないはず。で:
We can't chase her all the way underground.
She shouldn't be able to move properly with those wounds anyway. But――
m920210.大いなる魔力と上等なカボチャを贄する者あらば、\nカボチャの神たる我は何度でも蘇:
If one offers great magical power and fine pumpkins as a sacrifice,
I, the God of Pumpkins, shall be resurrected again and again, Kabo…
m920210.大切なカカオを守るため、\n我々はグルメジャングルに向かったのだった……。:
To protect our precious cacao,
we set off for the Gourmet Jungle…
m920210.姿が変わった……あれが本性なの？\n皆、ここからが本番よ！:
Her form has changed… is that her true nature?
Everyone, the real fight starts now!
m920210.強力かつ厄介な魔法を掛けられているようです。\nなのに、近付かないと魔力の乱れを:
She appears to be under a powerful and troublesome spell.
And yet, I couldn't sense the magical disturbance until I got close.
m920210.急ごしらえの気付け薬では目覚めませんでしたが、\n緊急対策チームが、総力を挙げて:
A hastily prepared stimulant failed to rouse them,
but the emergency response team is pooling all their resources to find a solution.
m920210.悪いが私たちは、似たような大義を掲げる\nもっと強大な奴と戦っている最中なんだ。:
I'm afraid we are currently battling a far more powerful entity
who claims a similar grand cause.
m920210.愛より出でて愛より赤く。\n私は何より人間がだいすき。\n老いて枯れゆき死に臨む:
??? : Redder than love, born of love.
Above all else, I love humans.
Before you age, wither, and face death, I shall grant you eternal rest.
m920210.操られた人たちは、順調に目を覚ましてる。\nただ、深く昏睡させられた人たちは別…:
The people who were under control are waking up smoothly.
It's just the ones who were put into a deep coma…
m920210.改心した訳ではないようだがな。\nともあれ、カカオは守れたんだ。こちらも撤退しよ:
It doesn't seem like they've truly reformed.
Still, we managed to protect the cocoa. We should withdraw as well.
m920210.昏睡していた女性たちは、皆意識を取り戻しましたね。\n全員が日常に戻りはじめ、後:
The women who were in comas have all regained consciousness.
They're all starting to return to their daily lives, and there are no aftereffects.
m920210.昏睡事件……『菓子にしてあげる』……。\nははぁ～ん、そいつはスィーテンの仕業だ:
The coma incident... "I'll turn you into sweets"...
Hah~n. That sounds like Sweeten's doing.
m920210.案内します――っと、すみません、立つのが大変で。: I'll show you the way—oh, I'm sorry, I'm having trouble standing.
m920210.正確に言うなら、『ただ生かし続ける魔術』が正しい。\n無辜の民らはそれを強制的に:
To be precise, it is a spell that simply keeps them alive.
The innocent populace was forcibly subjected to it,
leaving every one of them in a coma.
m920210.涙目の女の子相手に、寄ってたかって詰め寄ってる。\nあんなだからモテないのね。:
A group of guys cornering a teary-eyed girl.
No wonder he's not popular.
m920210.犯人のあてがあれば、こっちも格段に動きやすいわ。\n……だからダルク、そんな悔し:
Having a suspect makes things much easier for us.
…So, D'Arc, stop looking so bitter.
m920210.犯人は強く、それ以上に繊細で狡猾な奴ですよ。\nそんな存在が、思うまま悪意を振り:
The perpetrator is strong, but even more so, they are delicate and cunning.
If such an existence were to unleash their malice at will…
m920210.皆、先にスィーテンの居る街に行って？\n私は、この方を介抱しながら追いかけるから:
Everyone, please head to the town where Suiten is.
I'll stay here to tend to her and catch up with you.
m920210.私も、今はそちらが好きだ。\nでは行くぞ、突撃ーーーーッ！: I agree. Then let's go! Charge!
m920210.素直に考えればそうなるね。\n敵の力は災厄の魔女級……仮に濡れ衣だったとしても、:
If we take it at face value, that's the logical conclusion.
The enemy's power is on the level of a Calamity Witch… Even if Moron is being framed,
giving her a nudge should lead to some progress.
m920210.美しいもの？ そうね……。\n例えば、迫る危機を仲間へと伝えるため、\n文字通り:
Beautiful things? Well…
For instance, a proud knight who literally gave his body to warn his comrades of an approaching crisis.
m920210.背中に耳の穴みっつ空けといた。: I made three holes in her back where her ears should be.
m920210.花が萎れることが怖いから。永遠であってほしいから。\nなぜなら人間の心はうつくし:
I am afraid of flowers wilting. I want them to be eternal.
Because the human heart is beautiful――isn't it?
m920210.落ち着いてパレスちゃん、\nただの魔力の残滓だから。\nもっとも、相当ヤバい奴が:
Stay calm, Palace. It's just residual magic.
That said, it is proof that something quite dangerous was here…
m920210.行くよお前ら、\n真っ赤なジャムを浴びてきな！:
Go on, you lot!
Bath them in bright red jam!
--- scene: Nasty Deeds (battle, end) ---
m920210.街の者はこちらへ！\n二列に並んでついてきてくれ！:
Townsfolk, this way!
Line up in two rows and follow me!
m920210.被害者たる乙女らの生命は半永久的に安定するだろうが、\n目覚めることはない……手:
The lives of the young women who fell victim will remain semi-permanently stable,
but they will not wake up… unless someone takes action.
m920210.被害者の身体には、不気味な花が寄生していました。\n睡眠薬の原料となる花に似てい:
The victims' bodies were parasitized by an eerie flower.
It resembles a bloom used as an ingredient for sleeping draughts,
but its properties appear to have been drastically amplified by magic.
m920210.要するに、チョコ騎士団みたいなものね。\nチョコレートには近付けないよう注意しな:
In short, they're like a Knight Order of Chocolate.
We'll have to be careful not to get too close to the chocolate.
m920210.見て、街の人々？ の背中から、変な花が生えてる。\nあの花で、眠らせた人々を操っ:
Look at the townspeople? Strange flowers are growing out of their backs.
She must be using those flowers to put them to sleep and control them.
m920210.見ろ、いたいけなチョコ従士が\nお前のチョコを味見してから介錯を乞うている！:
Look! This poor Chocolate Servant
is begging for a mercy kill after tasting your chocolate!
m920210.謎の植物に意識を奪われかけた時、声を聞きました。\n『あまい』『うつくしい』『か:
Just as the mysterious plant was about to steal my consciousness, I heard a voice.
It said, "Sweet," "Beautiful," and "I'll make you a treat."
I suspect those were the culprit's words…
m920210.貴様らが行くと言うなら案内するが、\nモーロンはお菓子を操る魔女。\nもし我々が: If you're going, I'll guide you. But remember, Mooron is a witch who controls sweets. If she turns us into her servants, don't hesitate to attack.
m920210.違うッ、こいつ……！\nおいしい生チョコの作り方を伝えようと……！？:
No, wait… this guy…
He's trying to tell you how to make delicious fresh chocolate, isn't he?!
m920210.高潔な者の精神が、くすんでしまう可能性。\nそれが怖いから全員纏めて仮死にする、:
So the spirit of the noble can tarnish.
That's what you're afraid of, so you put everyone into a suspended animation?
You praise the human heart, yet you're a remarkably cowardly creature.
m920210.魔女……？\nスィーテンについて、なにか知っているの？:
The witch…?
Do you know anything about Sweeten?
m920210.（……いや、ここはグルメジャングル。\n復活が自然に起こったとしても、不思議では:
(…No, this is the Gourmet Jungle.
It wouldn't be surprising if the revival occurred naturally.)
m920210.（あの人、側近の邪仙と一緒に城下町で\n期間限定チョコあんみつ食べてたけど、黙っ:
(I saw him at the town square with his advisor, the Evil Immortal,
eating a limited-edition chocolate anmitsu. I'll keep that to myself.)
m920210.（ふふっ、いいじゃない。\nしたたかさもアンナさんの魅力だもの）:
(Hehe, that's alright.
Her shrewdness is part of her charm.)
m920210.（パンプキンデウス復活のための供物は、\n強大な魔力と上等なカボチャ、と言ってい:
(The offerings required for Pumpkin Deus's revival were said to be
powerful mana and high-quality pumpkins…
The mastermind is likely a sorcerer well-versed in botany…)
m920210.（五歳児の喧嘩みたい……）: (This is like a fight between five-year-olds……)
m920210.（残されたカボチャは、供物の横流しに過ぎない。\nこの冬場に、カボチャを捧げた者:
(The pumpkins left behind are nothing more than diverted offerings.
Are there really those who would offer pumpkins in the middle of winter?)
m920210.（特にあんただよ、踊り子の女。\n今夜にはもう、目を覚まさなくなるだろうからね…:
(Especially you, you little dancer.
By tonight, you'll never open your eyes again…)
m920210.（王子様のカボチャパンツ姿は、\nちょっとだけ見たかったなぁ……）:
(I just wanted to see the Prince in his pumpkin pants
for a little while…)
m920210.（素性の知れない女ではあるが、悪意は感じ取れない。\nだがこいつは恐らく……なら:
(She's a stranger, but I don't sense any malice in her.
If she really is… then what I should do now is…)

m920227.……たまにこういうこと言うんだよなー。: ……He does say stuff like that every now and then.
m920227.……なにか、鬼気迫るものがありましたわね。: ……There was a truly terrifying intensity to that.
m920227.……やっぱりやめとこうかしら。: ……Perhaps we should leave it at that.
m920227.……メーアもイメチェンするです？: ……Is Meer going to get a makeover too?
m920227.……凄い気迫だな、近寄り難いほどに。: ...His presence is overwhelming. Almost impossible to get close to.
m920227.……勝った？ そっ、それじゃあ！？: ……We won? Then, what does that mean!?
m920227.……相も変わらず凄い盛り上がりだな。\n決勝の相手は『虚空の花』の最後の一人。\:
……The crowd's as wild as ever.
Our opponent in the finals is the last of the "Flowers of the Void."
They're said to be the world's greatest Illusionist—
m920227.──ここが第一試合の会場になります。: ──This is the venue for the first match.
m920227.──これにて予選第二試合は終了です。\nそれではまた次の会場でお会いしましょう。: ──And with that, the second preliminary match is over. See you at the next venue.
m920227.──これより戦神コロッセウム・冒険者の部、\nブレイブリージャーニーの決勝戦を執: ──Now then, we shall hold the final match of the War God Colosseum, Adventurers' Division, for the Bravely Journey!
m920227.──さて、そろそろ勝ち名乗りの時間だ。: ──Now then, it is time for the victory announcement.
m920227.──勝者、王国の王子！: ──The winner is the Prince of the Kingdom!
m920227.『すでにこの地は私の領域、虚空の花園。\n貴女の全力を以って破ってみなさい、チェ:
『This land is already my domain, the Garden of the Void.
Break through it with all your might, Chelsea.
If you fail, I will have no choice but to take you back by force.』
m920227.『どこへなりともお行きなさい。\n今回の件は馬鹿弟子の放蕩ではなく、\n独り立ち:
『Go wherever you wish.
I'll consider this not the recklessness of a foolish disciple,
but her coming of age.』
m920227.『ならばこの一戦で証明してください。\n我が弟子が、真に戦士と成り得るのかを』:
『Then prove me wrong in this battle.
Show me whether my disciple can truly become a warrior.』
m920227.『ほう、私の言葉を否定しますか。\n普通なら一笑に付すところではありますが、\n:
『Oh? You dare deny my words?
I would normally dismiss it with a laugh,
but I cannot ignore the words of you, of all people.』
m920227.『今回の戦神コロッセウムの期間、\n私は貴女の戦いぶりを監視していました。\n率:
『During this War God Colosseum, I have been watching you fight.
To be frank, I am quite disappointed.』
m920227.『初対面の人間と長時間同じ空間にいたくありません』: 『I do not wish to spend long in the same space as someone I have just met.』
m920227.『実力不足、経験不足は問題ではありません。\n貴女には決定的に、戦う意志が欠如し:
『Lacking in skill or experience is one thing.
But you are fatally lacking the will to fight.』
m920227.『放蕩中の我が不肖の弟子に告げる。\n軍人ごっこはさっさと終わらせて、\n早く家:
???: 『To my wayward disciple, currently on a bender:
Cut the soldier act short and come home already.』
m920227.『自分でもよく分かっているでしょう。\n貴女はこの大会で何も成し遂げていない。\:
『You know it yourself, don't you?
You have accomplished nothing in this tournament.
You're just a useless burden hiding behind your companions—』
m920227.『自分は新人だから負けてたって仕方ない？\nそんな負け犬思考の人間はいるだけ邪魔: 『"I'm a rookie, so it's fine if I lose"? People with that loser mentality are nothing but a nuisance.』
m920227.『貴女のそれは、いつか仲間を殺しますよ』: 『That "someday" of yours will eventually kill your comrades.』
m920227.『貴女はいつか私のようになりたいと言いました。\nそのいつかとは具体的にいつのこ:
『You once said you wanted to become like me someday.
But just when, exactly, is this "someday"?』
m920227.『貴女はそこにいて良い水準の人間ではありません。\n取り返しのつかない事態になる:
『You are not good enough to be there.
Before things become irreversible, quit the army.』
m920227.あ、春嵐さんが射殺さんばかりの目でメーアを見てるです。: Oh, Spring Storm is looking at Meer with a "I'll shoot you dead" glare.
m920227.あっ、アタシもあの人見たことある！\n傭兵時代に一緒に戦ったことあるけど、\n砲:
Oh, I've seen her in action before!
We fought together during my mercenary days,
and she was a freak who shot down cannonballs with arrows!
m920227.あの御方は『虚空の花』の遊撃担当。\n東の国で一、二を争うほどの弓使いだ。:
That one is the skirmisher for the "Flowers of the Void."
She's one of the finest archers in the Eastern lands.
m920227.あの盾使いを倒すなんて、あんたらやっぱりすげぇな。: Taking down that shield user... you guys really are something else.
m920227.あら、矢文が届いたわね。どれどれ──: Oh, a message by arrow has arrived. Let's see──
m920227.あー、それなら知ってる知ってる。\n三代前に主君と親兄弟殺した家でしょ？\nあん: Oh, I know all about that. Three generations ago, they killed their lord and his entire family. I've been keeping my distance, so I'd rather not stir the pot.
m920227.うぉおおおおおおおおおッ！ 熱い闘いだったぜぇッ！: Whoooooaah! That was a hot fight!
m920227.うん、ボクもつい見入っちゃった。\nこれは負けていられないなぁ……。:
Yeah, I was totally captivated.
I can't afford to lose now...
m920227.え、ゴブリンがマイク持って……？: Huh, a goblin with a mic…?
m920227.おいおい、俺たちはこれでも歴戦の冒険者だぜ？\nあの戦神マレスから招待状だって届:
Hey, hey, we're still seasoned adventurers, you know!
We even got an invitation from the War God Mares,
though our healer is recovering, so we couldn't participate!
m920227.おっと、世界中の冒険者が勢揃いってか？: Whoa, looks like adventurers from all over the world have gathered.
m920227.おっと、嬢ちゃんの知り合いだったか。\n『虚空の花』といや俺たちの業界では有名で:
Oh, so they're your acquaintance.
The "Flower of the Void" is quite famous in our line of work,
one of the top three adventurer parties in the world.
m920227.お前たちの戦い一つ一つが！ その全てが！\nこの世界に住まう者たちの命を守ったの:
Every single battle you fought! All of it!
Carve this into your hearts: you protected the lives of all who dwell in this world!
m920227.お前たちの旅路！ お前たちの歩みを！\nこの戦神マレスが直々に見極めてやろう！:
Your journeys! Your strides!
I, the War God Mares, shall judge them myself!
m920227.お前たち！ 座席はそのまま、だぜ？: You all! Stay in your seats, got it?
m920227.お前の家は帝国だろ。: Your family is from the Empire, isn't it?
m920227.ここで戦わなきゃ冒険者じゃねぇ！\n全財産回復薬にベットしてやったぜ！:
If I don't fight here, I'm no adventurer!
I bet my entire fortune on recovery potions!
m920227.これも因果ってやつか、二戦連続で同じカードとはな。: I suppose it's fate that we're facing the same opponent in two straight matches.
m920227.これよりエキシビションマッチの参加制限を解く！\n戦いてぇ奴らは全員舞台に上がり:
I'm lifting the participation restrictions for the exhibition match!
Anyone who wants to fight, get up on that stage right now!
m920227.これより進行は私が取り仕切ります。\n今から本大会の資料を配布しますので、\n定:
I'll take charge of the proceedings from here.
I'll be distributing the tournament materials shortly, so please gather at the designated location by the appointed time.
m920227.こんな私を、信じてくれる人がいるから！: Because there are people who believe in someone like me!
m920227.さあ、お前たち。次なる旅路へと向かう時間だ。: Now then, you lot. It is time to set out on your next journey.
m920227.さあ、戦士たちの入場だッ！！: Now then, let the warriors enter!!
m920227.さすがは世界最高峰の冒険者パーティでしたね……。: Truly the world's greatest adventurer party...
m920227.しっかし、開幕からとんでもないカードだな。: Man, what a wild matchup to kick things off with.
m920227.すごいなぁ、ボクもすぐに追い越されちゃうかも？: Wow... I might get left behind in no time.
m920227.そう落ち込むことはありませんわよ。\n今回の戦いは少々レベルの方が高すぎて、\n: Please don't be so down. The level of this battle was a bit too high, to be honest. I didn't have much of a chance to shine either!!
m920227.そこまで、両者剣を収めろッ！: That's enough! Both of you, sheathe your swords!
m920227.そこまで！ 第一試合終了です！: That's enough! The first match is over!
m920227.そして実況と解説は俺が担当するぜ！: And I'll be handling the commentary!
m920227.そして願わくば、次の戦神コロッセウムで会おう。: And I pray we meet again at the next God of War Colosseum.
m920227.そもそもほんの少し前までは学生だった人間が、\nこんな世界の最前線にいる方がおか: Besides, it's strange that someone who was a student just a short while ago is standing on the front lines of this world!
m920227.それでは、勝者は次の会場へ移動してください。\n戦神マレスの名に恥じぬ戦いを期待:
Now then, the winners please move to the next venue.
I look forward to a battle worthy of the War God Maless's name.
m920227.それでは戦神コロッセウム・冒険者の部、\n予選最終試合を此処に執り行う。: Then, let us proceed with the final preliminaries of the War God Colosseum, Adventurers' Division.
m920227.それでは第一試合、開始です！: Then let's begin the first match!
m920227.それでは第二試合、開戦です！: Then, let us begin the second match!
m920227.それ変装ですよねぇ！？: That's just a disguise, you know!?
m920227.そろそろ幻術で話すのやめません？: Could you please stop talking through an illusion?
m920227.たった一人の幼子を救うために、命を張った者もいる。: Some even staked their lives to rescue a single, tiny child.
m920227.だが、よく聞け冒険者よ！ 死した戦士たちの魂もだ！\n今の物質界は、お前たちの献:
But hear me well, adventurers! Even the souls of the fallen warriors!
This material world exists only because of your dedication!
m920227.だが、冒険者の旅路はまだまだ終わらない！\n次は夢のエキシビションマッチの時間だ:
But the adventurers' journey is far from over!
Next up is the time for the dream exhibition match!
m920227.だけど、『虚空の花』はまだ三人残っている。\nまたいつ当たってもいいよう準備して:
But there are still three members of the "Flowers of the Void" left.
Stay ready, in case we run into them again.
m920227.ちなみに実家はとんでもない豪族な上に、\n代々策謀で成り上がってきた家系だそうだ:
By the way, her family is an incredibly wealthy clan.
They say they've risen to power through generations of scheming.
m920227.てかぶっちゃけ殺す気じゃなかったあの人？: Seriously, was that person actually trying to kill us?
m920227.ですが実際素晴らしい盾捌きでした。\n我々も見習うべき点は多かったかと。:
But her shield work was truly magnificent.
There were many points we should have learned from.
m920227.でも私は、師匠みたいになりたくて、\n色んな人の役に立ちたかったから──:
But I… I wanted to become like you, Master,
and help as many people as I could—
m920227.というか言うほどシールドバッシュだったっけ？\n盾の先端で突いてたような気がする:
Besides, was it really a shield bash?
I could've sworn she just jabbed us with the tip.
m920227.どれだけ無茶な乱れ射ちをしても、\n一向に矢玉が尽きる気配がないことから、\nつ:
No matter how wildly she sprays her arrows,
her quiver never seems to run dry.
Her nickname is the "Mad Spring Storm." A formidable foe.
m920227.なぁに、まだまだ尻の青いガキばっかりだ。\n実力はあっても経験不足はどうしようも:
Don't worry, they're still just greenhorns.
They may have the talent, but they lack experience.
There's still plenty of work for us veterans for a while yet.
m920227.なっ、なんでみなさんそんなに落ち着いてるんですか！？: W-Why are you all so calm about this!?
m920227.なになになに、顔と身体がコロコロ変わってるんだけど！: Wh-what's going on, why is the face and body changing so fast!
m920227.なるほどなぁ、今回はそう来たか。: I see. So that's how it is this time.
m920227.なんか百面相してる人がいるです。: There's someone over there with a thousand faces.
m920227.なんでお前が威張ってんだよ。: Why are you acting so smug?
m920227.はい、師匠たちはすっごく強いんです！: Yes, my master and her team are incredibly strong!
m920227.はい、私の師匠とパーティを組んでる冒険者さんです。\n両手に盾を持って戦う、とっ:
Yes, it's the adventurer who teams up with my master.
She fights with a shield in each hand, and she's such a reliable big sister……
m920227.はい先輩！ すぐに相談します！: Yes, senpai! I'll come to you right away!
m920227.はい先輩！ 初めてのことばっかりでまったくです！: Yes, senpai! It's all so new, it's been quite a lot to take in!
m920227.ひゅー、剣筋はもちろん去り際まで格好良いねぇ。: Whew, his swordsmanship was impressive, and his exit was stylish too.
m920227.ふぅ、素晴らしいシールドバッシュだったわね。\n名うてのシールドバッシャーとお見:
Phew, what a magnificent shield bash.
I'd say you're a renowned shield basher.
m920227.ふーん、あの二人にそこまで言わせるほどの使い手かぁ。: Hm, so he's the kind of fighter who can get those two to say that, huh.
m920227.ふーん、最近は若手がもりもりと育ってるのねぇ。\nニーカも今では兵士のみんなから:
Hm, the new generation is really blossoming these days.
Nika, you're already relied upon by all the soldiers, but
you should really be the one getting spoiled as a rookie.
m920227.へぇ、弓使いとしてはお近づきになってみたいわね。\nチェルシーちゃん、あの子って:
Hm, I'd like to get to know her better as an archer.
Chelsea, what's her personality like?
m920227.まあ……あれはもう季節型の台風みたいなもんだし。: Well... it's like a seasonal typhoon.
m920227.まさか本当にあの三人を倒しちまうとは、\nやっぱりあんたらってとんでもねぇんだな:
I can't believe we actually took down those three.
You guys really are something else.
m920227.まっ、うちのダニエラさんの敵ではなかったと。\nなんたってイメチェンをしたばっか: Well, she wasn't a match for our Daniela, anyway. After all, she just went through a total makeover!
m920227.よく戦った、冒険者たちよ。\n貴様ら、そのままで聞くが良い！\n今だけは俺様があ:
Well fought, adventurers.
Listen to me, just for a moment!
For now, I shall permit all forms of disrespect!
m920227.よく辿り着いた、長かった予選もこの試合で最後だ。: You made it in time. The long preliminaries end with this match.
m920227.エキシビションマッチ、開幕だ！: The exhibition match is about to begin!
m920227.キタキタキタァ！: Here they come, here they come!
m920227.ダークエルフの盾使い、東の国の弓使い、\n隻眼のソードマスターに稀代の大幻術士─:
A dark elf shield user, an archer from the Eastern Lands,
a one-eyed swordmaster, and a once-in-a-generation illusionist──
m920227.チェルシーちゃん、一緒に慣れていきましょうね？: Chelsea, let's get used to it together, okay?
m920227.チェルシーちゃん、王国軍にはもう馴染めましたか？: Chelsea, have you settled in with the Royal Army yet?
m920227.ヒーラー不在のパーティを成立させるタンク役、だもんね。: She's the tank role that makes a healer-less party work, right?
m920227.フゥーハハハハハッ！ 久しいな戦士たちよ！\n時は満ちた！ 新たなる祭典の始まり:
Fufufufufu! Long time no see, warriors!
The time has come! The new festival begins now!
m920227.ヘッドショットに対する並々ならぬ執念を感じました……。: I could feel an unusual obsession with landing headshots……
m920227.ミェール先輩……私、まったく動けなくて。\n折角の貴重な実戦の機会だったのに……: Miere-senpai…… I couldn't move at all. It was such a rare opportunity for real combat experience……
m920227.世界最高峰の冒険者パーティ『虚空の花』、\nそのリーダーを務める隻眼のソードマス: The world's top-tier adventurer party, "Flowers of the Void," and their leader, the one-eyed swordmaster.
m920227.両者構えて……始めッ！！: Both sides, take your positions... Begin!!
m920227.中には、その道の半ばで果てた者も多くいるだろう。: Many of you, I am sure, perished along the way.
m920227.予選勝ち抜き、おめでとうございます。\n決勝戦の詳細は追って通知しますので、\n:
Congratulations on clearing the preliminaries.
We'll notify you of the final match details later.
For now, please rest and recover.
m920227.人類のために神と戦った者がいる、\n国家のために魔物と戦った者もいる。:
Some fought the gods for the sake of humanity.
Others battled monsters to protect their nations.
m920227.今日此処に、お前たちのそれを体現する者たちがいる。: Today, in this place, stand those who embody your spirit.
m920227.伊達に世界は救っていない、というわけですね。: I suppose we haven't saved the world for nothing, then.
m920227.何度聞いても痺れる言葉だぜ……。: No matter how many times I hear it, that's a badass line……
m920227.依頼成功率は驚異の９８％を誇る凄腕だ。\n俺はあの人以上の冒険者を見たことがねぇ: He boasts an astonishing 98% mission success rate. I've never seen an adventurer more skilled than him.
m920227.俺様は此処に戦神コロッセウム・冒険者の部！\n『ブレイブリージャーニー』の開幕を:
I declare the opening of the War God Colosseum, Adventurer Division!
"Bravely Journey" is now underway!
m920227.先日入隊されたばかりのチェルシーさんです。\n高名な魔術師のお弟子さんで幻術を操:
That's Chelsea. She just enlisted the other day.
She's an apprentice to a renowned mage, and I hear she specializes in illusion magic.
m920227.全冒険者の憧れと言っても過言じゃねぇ。: You could say they're the dream team for every adventurer.
m920227.全力の『虚空の花』と王国の対戦かよ、\nこいつぁ絶対に見逃せないカードだぜ！:
The full-power "Flowers of the Void" versus the Kingdom……
This is a match we absolutely can't miss!
m920227.冒険者たちよ、今大会最後の祭りだ！！\nド派手な花火を打ち上げやがれぇぇッ！！:
Adventurers! This is the final festival of the tournament!!
Let's light up the sky with some spectacular fireworks!!
m920227.冒険者よ！ 自由を愛する者！ 誇りに生きる者！\n勇を携え未知へと挑み、見果てぬ:
Adventurers! You who love freedom! You who live with pride!
You who carry courage to challenge the unknown and chase endless dreams!
m920227.刹那に生きる者たちよ、今だけは夢に酔いしれるが良い！: You who live for the moment—indulge in your dreams, just for now!
m920227.剣士であれば必ず一度は耳にする生きる伝説。\nまさか斯様な場所で出会えるとは、僥:
A living legend every swordsman hears of at least once.
To cross paths with him in a place like this... it's a stroke of luck.
m920227.同感だな、いつか手合わせをしてみたいと思っていた。\nあんまりにも表に出てこない:
I agree. I've always wanted to test my skills against him.
He rarely shows himself in public, so I'd almost given up hope.
But I'm not about to let this chance slip away.
m920227.外部聴講生として学園にもよく来ていまして。\n真面目で努力家、将来有望ないい子で:
She's also a regular visitor to the academy as an external auditor.
She's diligent, hardworking, and has a bright future ahead of her.
m920227.学園がコツコツやってきたことが実を結び始めたのさ。\nこれから優秀で意欲的な人材:
The academy's steady efforts are finally bearing fruit.
We'll be seeing a flood of talented and motivated recruits from here on out.
m920227.嵐の上に狂ってんのか、とんでもねぇな。: A storm that's gone mad? That's quite something.
m920227.師匠は知らない人が苦手なので、\n幻術を使わないと喋れないんです。:
Master is bad with strangers, so
she can't speak unless she uses her illusions.
m920227.師匠曰く『ヒーラーがいるという安心感は、\n戦闘から緊張感を奪い、パーティに油断:
My master says that "the sense of security a healer provides
strips the tension from battle and breeds complacency in the party.
A true adventurer fights with healing potions." That's their policy……
m920227.幻術だ！ 構えろ、戦いはすでに始まっている！: It's an illusion! Take your guard, the battle has already begun!
m920227.広大なる野原をどこまでも進め、決して足を止めるな。: March across the vast plains and never stop your feet.
m920227.強そうな人たちが強そうな雰囲気出してる！！: The strong people are putting off such a strong vibe!!
m920227.我が国の弓取りで知らぬ者はいない有名な方ですね。\nなんでも妖力で編んだ弓矢を使:
She's a famous figure even in our country, known for her archery.
I hear she shoots enemies with arrows woven from yōki.
m920227.戦神コロッセウム・冒険者の部！\nブレイブリージャーニーの優勝者は──王国の王子:
War God Colosseum, Adventurer Division!
The winner of the Bravely Journey is──the Kingdom's Prince!
m920227.戦神マレスは、お前たちを誇りに思う。: I, Mares, God of War, am proud of you.
m920227.早急に遠征準備を整える必要がありそうですね。\n私の方で冒険者の方々に招集をかけ:
We'll need to prepare for the expedition immediately.
I'll send out the summons to the adventurers.
m920227.普段はとても優雅で穏やかなお姉さんなのですが、\nいざ戦いになると口が悪くなって:
She's usually a very graceful and gentle big sister type,
but when battle starts, she gets foul-mouthed and her face gets scary!
m920227.最終戦のカードは、まあ大方の予想通りだな。: The card for the final round is, well, exactly what most people expected.
m920227.最近は、冒険者の数も増えてるって聞きますわよ？: I've heard that the number of adventurers has been increasing lately.
m920227.最高じゃねぇか！ やっぱそうでなくちゃなァ！: That's the spirit! This is exactly how it should be!
m920227.来ると分かってるもんに驚く理由もねぇよ。\n今回はお忙しいのか映像でのご登場だし:
There's no reason to be surprised when you know it's coming.
Looks like he's busy, so he's making a video appearance this time.
m920227.来ォい！ 相手になってやるぜぇッ！: Come on then! I'll be your match!
m920227.正しく『冒険』をする余裕ができてきたってことか、\n良い世の中になったもんじゃね:
So people finally have the leisure to go on "adventures" in the true sense.
Things really are getting better.
m920227.正直なのはとてもいいことですねー。\n何かあったらすぐに相談してください。:
Honesty is a wonderful quality.
If anything comes up, please don't hesitate to talk to me.
m920227.然り、これ以上は命のやり取りになりましょう。: Indeed. Going any further would mean risking our lives.
m920227.物質界の治安は全体的に上昇傾向にあるので、\n討伐系の依頼が減ったのが大きそうで:
Since public safety in the Material World has been improving overall,
the drop in subjugation requests is likely a major factor.
m920227.盾を以って目前の困難を打ち砕く──\nつまりは広義のシールドバッシュね！:
To shatter the difficulties before you with a shield—
that is, in the broadest sense, a shield bash!
m920227.盾使いのことシールドバッシャーって言うのお前だけだよ。: You're the only one who calls shield users "shield bashers."
m920227.私たちに足りないものは実戦経験、\n焦ってどうにかなるものではありません。\nゆ: What we lack is practical combat experience. It's not something that can be fixed in a rush. We just need to learn at our own pace.
m920227.第二試合の会場はここになります。: This is the venue for the second match.
m920227.自由を愛する者たちよ！ 誇りに生きる者たちよ！\n勇を携え野原に立ち、未知を既知:
Those who love freedom! Those who live with pride!
Those who stand in the fields with courage, turning the unknown into the known!
If you wish to grasp glory yet unseen, gather beneath my banner!
m920227.若き幻術士よ、すでに勝負はついた。\nそれ以上は無用な禍根を残すことになる。\n:
Young illusionist, the match is already decided.
Going any further would only leave unnecessary scars.
You have no objections, Flower of the Void?
m920227.行くぜ王国！ 成長した俺たちの力を見せてやらァ！: Here we come, Kingdom! Let's show you the power of who we've become!
m920227.街を守るための戦いがあった。\n村落を守る戦いもあったはずだ。:
There were battles fought to defend cities.
And surely, others to protect humble villages.
m920227.見知った顔も多いですが、新顔もかなり多いですね。: I recognize quite a few faces, but there are a lot of newcomers too.
m920227.馬車を守る戦いだったかもしれん、\n畑を守る戦いだったかもしれん。:
Perhaps it was a battle to save a single carriage.
Or maybe, to defend a patch of farmland.
m920227.馬鹿で上等！ 自由に生きてこその冒険者だぜ！: Being an idiot is fine! Living freely is what makes us adventurers!
m920227.馬鹿は馬鹿でも、馬鹿をやり通す実力がある。\nマレスの野郎もそうだが、そういうや:
Stupid, sure, but she has the skill to pull it off.
That Mares guy is the same way. Those kinds of people are strong, you know?
m920227.馬鹿ばっかです？: You guys are all such idiots.
m920227.魔王の復活から、天界との決戦まで。\nこれまでにお前たち冒険者は一度は必ず、\n:
From the Demon King's revival to the decisive battle with the Celestial Realm.
Up until now, you adventurers have surely all fought
to protect something at least once.
m920227.（……チェルシーは昔から自身を過小評価しがちでした）: (……Chelsea has always tended to underestimate herself.)
m920227.（これが娘が嫁に行く親の気持ちなのでしょうか。\nであれば、嫁ぎ先への八つ当たり:
(Is this how a parent feels when their daughter marries?
If so, taking it out on the groom is a natural right──)
m920227.（それは私を筆頭に『虚空の花』という、\n各分野の天才たちに囲まれて育ったゆえの:
(It is a bad habit born from growing up surrounded by the geniuses
of the “Flowers of the Void,” myself included……)
m920227.（ちょっと王国、倒しちゃいます？）: (Shall I just go ahead and take down the Kingdom?)
m920227.（やっぱり私じゃ師匠に及ばない……！\n地力も、経験も、幻術の精度も天と地！）:
(I still can't compare to Master……!
In raw power, experience, and even the precision of her illusions, it's like day and night!)
m920227.（ソードマスターさんが無言で帰っていくのです……）: (The Swordmaster is leaving without a word...)
m920227.（最愛の弟子が自分の手を離れていくというのは、\n嬉しくもありますが同時に、中々:
(Watching my dearest disciple drift away from my side……
it brings me joy, but it is also rather lonely.)
m920227.（私、ここでやっていけるかなぁ……）: (Do I really have what it takes to keep up here……?)
m920227.（私もいつか、あんな風になれるのかな？）: (Can I ever become someone like that one day?)
m920227.（自分は凡人であるという思い込みは根深く、\n私たちの誰かが諭したところで効果は:
(Her belief that she is merely ordinary is deeply rooted,
and no amount of advice from us will change it.
I was right to judge that drastic measures were needed, but……)
m920227.（見えなかった、動けなかった、それは構わない。\n実力が足りないのなら努力して強:
(I couldn't see, I couldn't move. That's fine.
If I lack the skill, I'll just work harder to get stronger.)
